FROM treatmentbasics;

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', remeddue) AS audit_month,
    AVG(critfindnum) AS avg_severity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(critfindnum) DESC) AS severity_rank
FROM 
    AuditAndCompliance
WHERE 
    remedstate ILIKE '%severe%'
GROUP BY 
    audit_month
ORDER BY 
    avg_severity DESC;

    ptsval AS "fan value"
FROM
    fans
GROUP BY

    "fan value";
CREATE INDEX idx_users_user_preferences_interests ON users USING GIN (user_preferences);

SELECT
    t1.beneregistry AS "Beneficiary Registry ID",
    t1.distequityidx AS "Equity Value",
    CASE
        WHEN t1.distequityidx > 0.5 THEN 'Resource Distribution Inequity'
        ELSE 'Normal Distribution'
    END AS "Distribution Status",
    (t2.impactmetrics->>'affected')::int AS "Disaster-Affected Population"
FROM
    beneficiariesandassessments AS t1
JOIN
    disasterevents AS t2 ON t1.benedistref = t2.distregistry
ORDER BY
    "Beneficiary Registry ID" ASC;

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', remeddue) AS audit_month,
    AVG(critfindnum) AS avg_severity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(critfindnum) DESC) AS severity_rank
FROM 
    AuditAndCompliance
WHERE 
    residrisklevel ILIKE '%severe%'
GROUP BY 
    audit_month
ORDER BY 
    avg_severity DESC;

WITH therapy_changes AS (
    SELECT
        (therapy_details ->> 'changes') AS change_type,
        (therapy_details ->> 'engagement') AS therapy_engagement_score
    FROM treatmentbasics
),
change_counts AS (
    SELECT
        change_type,
        COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences
    FROM therapy_changes
    GROUP BY change_type
),
engagement_variations AS (
    SELECT
        change_type,
        AVG(therapy_engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score
    FROM therapy_changes
    GROUP BY change_type
)
SELECT
    cc.change_type,
    cc.total_occurrences,
    ev.avg_engagement_score
FROM change_counts cc
JOIN engagement_variations ev ON cc.change_type = ev.change_type
ORDER BY cc.total_occurrences DESC;

WITH ranked_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex AS account_id,
        ma.authenscore AS engagement_authenticity_score,
        sb.acttimedist->>'timing_pattern' AS timing_pattern,
        'Manipulator' AS status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ma.authenscore DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        account a
    JOIN 
        profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN 
        sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    JOIN 
        moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
)
SELECT 
    account_id, 
    engagement_authenticity_score,
    timing_pattern,
    status
FROM 
    ranked_accounts
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    f.fackey AS facility_key,
    corr(
        (
            f.support_and_resources->>'resource_adequacy_score'
        )::float,
        (
            t.txadh
        )::float
    ) AS correlation_coefficient,
    avg(
        (
            f.support_and_resources->>'overall_support_index'
        )::float
    ) AS overall_support_index
FROM 
    facilities f
JOIN 
    treatmentoutcomes t ON f.fackey = t.txadh
GROUP BY 
    f.fackey;

WITH ContainerEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry AS container_id,
        (ser * cei * (1 - cri)) AS efficiency_score,
        s.tempstabidx AS temperature_stability,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ser * cei * (1 - cri)) DESC) AS efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        container c
    JOIN 
        sensordata s ON c.containregistry = s.containlink
    JOIN 
        regulatoryandmaintenance r ON c.shipown = r.shipgov
)
SELECT 
    container_id,
    efficiency_score,
    temperature_stability,
    efficiency_rank
FROM 
    ContainerEfficiency
WHERE 
    efficiency_score > 75
ORDER BY 
    efficiency_rank
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    de.distregistry AS registry_id,
    (
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                ELSE 0.0
            END
        ) * (
            CASE 
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * (
            1 - (
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) / 6.0
            )
        )
    ) AS health_resilience_score,
    (
        CASE 
            WHEN 
                (
                    (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                            WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                            WHEN eh.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                            ELSE 0.0
                        END
                    ) * (
                        CASE 
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                            WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ) * (
                        1 - (
                            (
                                CASE 
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                                    ELSE 0
                                END
                            ) / 6.0
                        )
                    )
                ) < 0.5 THEN 'Health Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
        END 
    ) AS health_status
FROM 
    disasterevents de
JOIN 
    environmentandhealth eh ON de.distregistry = eh.envdistref
ORDER BY 
    de.distregistry;

SELECT
    change_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
    AVG(
        CAST(
            engagement_score_variation AS NUMERIC
        )
    ) AS average_engagement_score_variation
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            (
                therapy_details ->> 'changes'::TEXT
            )::VARCHAR AS change_type,
            (
                therapy_details ->> 'engagement'::TEXT
            )::VARCHAR AS previous_engagement,
            LEAD(
                (
                    therapy_details ->> 'engagement'::TEXT
                )
            ) OVER (
                ORDER BY txkey
            ) AS next_engagement
        FROM
            treatmentbasics
    ) AS subquery
WHERE
    change_type IS NOT NULL
    AND previous_engagement IS NOT NULL
    AND next_engagement IS NOT NULL
    AND previous_engagement <> next_engagement
GROUP BY
    change_type
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    t1.accindex AS account_id,
    t2.detection_score_profile -> 'behavior_scores' ->> 'botlikscore' AS bot_behavior_index,
    CASE
        WHEN (t2.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'riskval')::float > 7 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (t2.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'riskval')::float BETWEEN 3 AND 7 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS risk_tier
FROM
    account AS t1
JOIN
    securitydetection AS t2 ON t2.sectechref = t1.accindex
WHERE
    t1.acctstatus ILIKE 'Inactive'
    OR t1.acctstatus ILIKE 'Dormant'
ORDER BY
    risk_tier DESC;

SELECT
    t1.accindex AS account_id,
    t2.detection_score_profile -> 'behavior_scores' ->> 'botlikscore' AS bot_behavior_index,
    CASE
        WHEN (t2.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'riskval')::float > 7 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (t2.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'riskval')::float BETWEEN 3 AND 7 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS risk_tier
FROM
    account AS t1
JOIN
    securitydetection AS t2 ON t2.sectechref = t1.accindex
WHERE
    t1.acctstatus = 'Inactive'
    OR t1.acctstatus = 'Dormant'

WITH therapy_changes AS (
    SELECT
        (
            therapy_details ->> 'changes'::TEXT
        )::VARCHAR AS change_type,
        (
            therapy_details ->> 'engagement'::TEXT
        )::VARCHAR AS previous_engagement,
        LEAD(
            (
                therapy_details ->> 'engagement'::TEXT
            )
        ) OVER (
            ORDER BY txkey
        ) AS next_engagement
    FROM
        treatmentbasics
),
engagement_variations AS (
    SELECT
        change_type,
        previous_engagement,
        next_engagement,
        CASE
            WHEN previous_engagement = next_engagement THEN 0
            WHEN previous_engagement IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN next_engagement IS NULL THEN -1
            ELSE (
                (
                    SELECT engagement_order
                    FROM (
                        VALUES
                            ('Non-compliant', 1),
                            ('Low', 2),
                            ('Medium', 3),
                            ('High', 4)
                        ) AS t (engagement_level, engagement_order)
                    WHERE
                        t.engagement_level = next_engagement
                ) - (
                    SELECT engagement_order
                    FROM (
                        VALUES
                            ('Non-compliant', 1),
                            ('Low', 2),
                            ('Medium', 3),
                            ('High', 4)
                        ) AS t (engagement_level, engagement_order)
                    WHERE
                        t.engagement_level = previous_engagement
                )
            )
        END AS engagement_variation
    FROM
        therapy_changes
)
SELECT
    change_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
    AVG(
        CAST(
            engagement_variation AS NUMERIC
        )
    ) AS average_engagement_variation
FROM
    engagement_variations
GROUP BY
    change_type
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.initdate)) AS panel_age,
    AVG(pn.paneeffpct) AS average_efficiency,
    COUNT(pn.panemark) AS number_of_panels
FROM 
    plant AS p
JOIN 
    panel AS pn ON p.growregistry = pn.hubregistry
GROUP BY 
    panel_age

    panel_age;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN atmostransparency > 0.5 THEN TRUE 
    ELSE FALSE 
  END AS meets_good_conditions, 
  COUNT(observstation) AS station_count, 
  AVG(atmostransparency) AS avg_aoi, 
  json_agg( 
    json_build_object( 
      'station_name', observstation, 
      'aoi_value', atmostransparency, 
      'lunar_factors', json_build_object( 
        'lunar_stage', lunarstage, 
        'lunar_distance', lunardistdeg 
      ), 
      'solar_condition', solarstatus 
    ) 
  ) AS environmental_factors 
FROM 
  observatories 
GROUP BY 
  meets_good_conditions;

SELECT

    t1.benedistref AS "Disaster Reference",
    t1.commengagelvl AS "CEE Score",
    t2.hazlevel AS "Classification",
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.commengagelvl ORDER BY t1.commengagelvl) AS rank
FROM
    beneficiariesandassessments AS t1
JOIN
    disasterevents AS t2 ON t1.benedistref = t2.distregistry

SELECT 
    a.acctident AS account_id,
    ma.netinflscore AS overall_reach_score,
    cb.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    ma.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON ma.macntref = cb.cntref
WHERE 
    ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier' 
    AND ma.netinflscore > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY netinflscore) FROM moderationaction)
ORDER BY 
    ma.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cri AS (
  SELECT 
    t2.vehiclereg AS vehicle_id, 
    t2.shiptransit AS shipment_id, 
    t4.datapct AS completion_percentage, 
    t3.coolremainpct AS coolant_remaining_percentage, 
    t1.riskflag AS max_container_risk_index, 
    t2.distdonekm AS distance_in_kilometers,
    t5.tempdevcount AS max_temperature_deviation_count,
    t5.critevents AS max_critical_events,
    t5.tempstabidx AS max_temperature_stability_index
  FROM 
    regulatoryandmaintenance AS t1 
    JOIN transportinfo AS t2 ON t1.vehgov = t2.vehiclereg 
    JOIN container AS t3 ON t2.containtransit = t3.containregistry 
    JOIN datalogger AS t4 ON t3.containregistry = t4.containlog 
    JOIN sensordata AS t5 ON t2.vehiclereg = t5.vehsenseref
  WHERE 
    t1.riskflag = 'High Risk'
)
SELECT 
  vehicle_id, 
  shipment_id, 
  completion_percentage, 
  max_container_risk_index, 
  distance_in_kilometers, 
  max_temperature_deviation_count, 
  max_critical_events, 
  max_temperature_stability_index, 
  coolant_remaining_percentage 
FROM 
  cri 
ORDER BY 
  max_container_risk_index 
LIMIT 
  10;

SELECT 
    a.acctident AS account_id,
    ma.netinflscore AS overall_reach_score,
    cb.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    ma.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
JOIN 
    contentbehavior cb ON ma.macntref = cb.cntref
WHERE 
    ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier'
ORDER BY 
    ma.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

UPDATE operations
SET opsstatus =
    CASE
        WHEN c.reportcompliance > 90 THEN 'Completed'
        WHEN c.reportcompliance BETWEEN 40 AND 90 THEN 'Scaling Down'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END
FROM coordinationandevaluation c
WHERE operations.opsregistry = c.coordopsref;

    SELECT 
        t1.clientseg AS customer_segment,
        t2.debincratio AS debt_to_income_ratio
    FROM 
        core_record AS t1
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref
),
SegmentStats AS (
    SELECT

        AVG(debt_to_income_ratio) AS avg_debt_to_income_ratio,
        COUNT(customer_segment) AS customer_count

FROM

    SegmentStats

SELECT 
    comm.commregistry AS communication_registry,
    risk.riskregistry AS communication_risk,
    comm.vpnflag AS vpn_usage,
    comm.langpattern AS language_pattern,
    comm.msgtally AS message_count,
    CASE
        WHEN nb_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' = 'High-risk' THEN 'Deceptive Pattern'
        WHEN nb_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' = 'Suspicious' THEN 'Deceptive Pattern'
        WHEN nb_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' = 'Normal' THEN 'Normal Pattern'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS communication_pattern
FROM 
    communication AS comm
JOIN 
    riskanalysis AS risk ON comm.commregistry = risk.commref
ORDER BY 
    communication_pattern DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(treatment_id INT)
RETURNS INT AS $ $
DECLARE
    engagement_rating INT;
BEGIN
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
            ELSE NULL
        END
    INTO engagement_rating
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE txkey = treatment_id;

    RETURN engagement_rating;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

GrandTotal AS (

  e.equipmenttype AS equipment_type, 
  l.lifesupportstatus AS life_support_status, 
  e.reliabilityindex AS reliability_score, 
  NULL AS reliability_classification, 
  json_build_object(
    'oxygen_status', l.oxygensupplystatus,
    'medical_status', l.medicalequipmentstatus,
    'safety_system_status', l.safetysystemstatus
  ) AS support_systems_status 
FROM 
  equipment AS e 
  JOIN lightingandsafety AS l ON e.equipmentcode = l.lighteqref 
WHERE 
  e.equipmenttype = 'Safety' 
ORDER BY 
  e.equipmentcode;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_account_technical_evasion_risk AS
SELECT 
    t1.accindex,
    t1.acctident,
    t1.acctcategory,
    t1.acctstatus,
    t1.authstatus,
    (0.4 * t2.vpnratio + 0.3 * t2.proxycount/10 + 0.3 * t2.ipcountrynum/20) AS technical_evasion_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN (0.4 * t2.vpnratio + 0.3 * t2.proxycount/10 + 0.3 * t2.ipcountrynum/20) < 0.3 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN (0.4 * t2.vpnratio + 0.3 * t2.proxycount/10 + 0.3 * t2.ipcountrynum/20) < 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_level
FROM 
    account AS t1
JOIN 
    technicalinfo AS t2 ON t1.accindex = t2.techkey;

SELECT 
    jsonb_extract_path_text(rm.risk_margin_profile, 'margin_rates', 'margrate') AS risk_margin_pivot,
    o.notionsum AS notional_value,
    ms.volmeter AS volatility_measure,
    -- Calculate PVaR using the formula: PVaR = Notional Value * Risk Margin Rate * Volatility Measure
    (o.notionsum * CAST(jsonb_extract_path_text(rm.risk_margin_profile, 'margin_rates', 'margrate') AS DECIMAL) * ms.volmeter) AS pvar
FROM 
    riskandmargin rm
JOIN 
    orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN 
    marketstats ms ON o.mktnote = ms.mdlink;

    COUNT(CASE WHEN intcheck = 'Failed' OR csumverify = 'Failed' THEN 1 END) AS failure_count,
    STRING_AGG(
        CASE 
            WHEN intcheck = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check'
            WHEN csumverify = 'Failed' THEN 'Checksum Verification'
        END, ', ' 
    ) AS failure_types
FROM 
    DataProfile
WHERE 
    intcheck = 'Failed' OR csumverify = 'Failed'
GROUP BY 
    profiletrace
ORDER BY 
    failure_count DESC

WITH latest_maintenance AS (
    SELECT 
        upkeeprobot AS bot_id,
        issuelevelval AS fault_risk,
        faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upkeeprobot ORDER BY rects DESC) AS rn
    FROM 
        maintenance_and_fault AS m
    JOIN robot_record AS r ON m.upkeepactuation = r.recreg
),
safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS bot_id,
        (safety_metrics->>'safety_incident_score')::FLOAT AS safety_incident_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety
)
SELECT 
    l.bot_id,
    s.safety_incident_score,
    l.fault_prediction_score
FROM 
    latest_maintenance AS l
JOIN safety_scores AS s ON l.bot_id = s.bot_id
WHERE 
    l.rn = 1
    AND l.fault_risk = 'High'
    AND s.safety_incident_score > 0
ORDER BY 
    s.safety_incident_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    sp.flowsoft AS processing_software,
    sp.flowstage AS processing_stage,
    AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
    AVG(sp.proccpu) AS avg_cpu_usage_percent,
    AVG(sp.procgpu) AS avg_gpu_usage_percent,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_data_size_gb,
    AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) AS avg_efficiency_value,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
        WHEN AVG((sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
        ELSE 'Needs Optimization'
    END AS efficiency_status,
    COUNT(*) AS total_workflow_count
FROM
    scanprocessing AS sp
JOIN
    equipment AS eq ON sp.equipref = eq.equipregistry
GROUP BY
    sp.flowsoft, sp.flowstage;

    t1.irs,
    t3.joyprec AS joystick_precision,
    t3.driftres AS drift_resistance,

    deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.sessionregistry = t2.devsessionref

    t1.irs > 8.0 AND
    t3.joyprec > 9.0 AND
    t3.driftres > 9.5 AND
    t3.trigres >= 5 AND
    t3.hapstr > 8;

        WHEN corrscore BETWEEN 0.7 AND 0.89 THEN 'Medium'

WITH high_risk_cases AS (
    SELECT 
        e.facid,
        COUNT(*) AS high_risk_count,
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.enckey) OVER (PARTITION BY e.facid) AS high_risk_percentage
    FROM 
        encounters e
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics a ON e.abref = a.abkey
    JOIN 
        assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON a.abkey = asr.asrkey
    WHERE 
        asr.mental_health_scores->'High-Risk Patient' ILIKE '%high risk%'
    GROUP BY 
        e.facid
),
facility_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey,
        f.support_and_resources->>'FRAI' AS FRAI,
        f.support_and_resources->>'PFIS' AS PFIS,
        hr.high_risk_percentage,
        (
            CAST(f.support_and_resources->>'FRAI' AS NUMERIC) - 
            CAST(f.support_and_resources->>'PFIS' AS NUMERIC)
        ) AS RDD
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        high_risk_cases hr ON f.fackey = hr.facid
    WHERE 
        hr.high_risk_percentage > 20
)
SELECT 
    fackey,
    PFIS,
    FRAI,
    RDD
FROM 
    facility_metrics
ORDER BY 
    RDD DESC;

SELECT 
    ra.artrefconcerned AS artifact_id,
    TETL.tetl_score
FROM 
    riskassessments ra
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        artrefconcerned,
        SUM(
            conservepriorityscore * tetl
        ) AS tetl_score
    FROM 
        riskassessments
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 
            unnest(array['Low', 'Medium', 'High']) AS tetl,
            unnest(array[1, 2, 3]) AS tetl_multiplier
    ) AS tetl_values
    WHERE 
        riskassesslevel = tetl
    GROUP BY 
        artrefconcerned
) AS TETL ON ra.artrefconcerned = TETL.artrefconcerned
ORDER BY 
    tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

facility_metrics AS (

        f.fackey,

WITH article_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.catlabel AS article_category,
        t1.difflevel AS complexity_level,
        -- Calculate ARS using the formula provided
        (
            t1.readsec * LOG(t1.wordlen) / 
            CASE 
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Basic' THEN 1
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Advanced' THEN 2
                ELSE 1.2
            END
        ) AS ars,
        -- Extract engagement rate from the JSONB column
        (t1.engagement_metrics->>'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate
    FROM 
        articles AS t1
),
average_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        AVG(ars) AS avg_ars,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate
    FROM 
        article_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
),
complexity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        complexity_level,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        article_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category, complexity_level
),
correlation_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        am.article_category,
        CORR(am.ars, am.engagement_rate) AS correlation_coefficient
    FROM 
        article_metrics AS am
    GROUP BY 
        am.article_category
)
SELECT 
    am.article_category,
    am.avg_ars,
    am.avg_engagement_rate,
    cm.correlation_coefficient,
    cc.complexity_level,
    cc.article_count
FROM 
    average_metrics AS am
JOIN 
    correlation_metrics AS cm ON am.article_category = cm.article_category
JOIN 
    complexity_counts AS cc ON am.article_category = cc.article_category
ORDER BY 
    am.article_category;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trader_omi_distribution(
    trader_ref VARCHAR
)
RETURNS TABLE (
    trader_id VARCHAR,
    transaction_count BIGINT,
    omi_mean FLOAT,
    omi_stddev FLOAT,
    omi_min FLOAT,
    omi_max FLOAT
) AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY 
    SELECT 
        trdref AS trader_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        AVG(CASE WHEN cancelpct <> 1 THEN modfreq / (1 - cancelpct) ELSE NULL END) AS omi_mean,
        STDDEV(CASE WHEN cancelpct <> 1 THEN modfreq / (1 - cancelpct) ELSE NULL END) AS omi_stddev,
        MIN(CASE WHEN cancelpct <> 1 THEN modfreq / (1 - cancelpct) ELSE NULL END) AS omi_min,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cancelpct <> 1 THEN modfreq / (1 - cancelpct) ELSE NULL END) AS omi_max
    FROM 
        transactionrecord
    WHERE 
        trdref = trader_ref
    GROUP BY 
        trdref;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH recent_period AS (

),
recent_transport_modes AS (

        COUNT(DISTINCT ti.vehiclereg) AS vehicles_stable_transport,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN sd."Stable Transport" = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS reliable_instances_count
    FROM transportinfo ti
    JOIN sensordata sd ON ti.vehiclereg = sd.vehsenseref
    WHERE sd.alerttime = (
        SELECT recent_date 
        FROM recent_period
    )
    GROUP BY ti.transmode
)

SELECT

FROM

JOIN (
    SELECT

        SUM(
            conservepriorityscore * tetl_multiplier
        ) AS tetl_score
    FROM 
        riskassessments
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 
            unnest(array['Low', 'Medium', 'High']) AS tetl,
            unnest(array[1, 2, 3]) AS tetl_multiplier
    ) AS tetl_values
    WHERE 
        riskassesslevel = tetl
    GROUP BY 
        artrefconcerned
) AS TETL ON ra.artrefconcerned = TETL.artrefconcerned
ORDER BY 
    tetl_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.growalias AS site_name,
    pan.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.initdate AS start_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate) AS service_years,
    eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS efficiency_values,
    eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS annual_degradation_rate,
    eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'efflosspct' AS efficiency_loss_metric,
    -- Calculate NDI using the formula provided
    (
        (
            CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
            -
            (
                CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS DECIMAL)
                *
                (
                    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate)
                )
            )
        )
        / CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
    ) AS calculated_ndi,
    -- Categorize panels based on NDI
    CASE
        WHEN (
            (
                CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
                -
                (
                    CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS DECIMAL)
                    *
                    (
                        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate)
                    )
                )
            )
            / CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
        ) > 0.8 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (
            (
                CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
                -
                (
                    CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' AS DECIMAL)
                    *
                    (
                        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.initdate)
                    )
                )
            )
            / CAST(eff.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS DECIMAL)
        ) BETWEEN 0.6 AND 0.8 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS panel_category
FROM
    plant p
JOIN
    panel pan ON p.growregistry = pan.hubregistry
JOIN
    performance eff ON pan.panemark = eff.solmodref;

    DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_DATE - a.remeddue) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    dataflow AS df

-- Filter for significant compliance issues and slow remediation

    a.remedstate = 'In Progress' 
    AND (CURRENT_DATE - a.remeddue) BETWEEN -5 AND 0

WITH DynastyArtifactCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        SUM(t4.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t3.budgetallocstatus ILIKE 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t3.budgetallocstatus ILIKE 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(t2.conservediff) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance AS t3 ON t1.artregistry = t3.artrefmaintained
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artrefconcerned
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artdynasty
),
BudgetStatus AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM artifactscore AS t5
                JOIN artifactratings AS t6 ON t5.artregistry = t6.artref
                JOIN conservationandmaintenance AS t7 ON t5.artregistry = t7.artrefmaintained
                WHERE 
                    t5.artdynasty = t1.artdynasty
                    AND t6.conservediff < 0.5
                    AND t7.budgetallocstatus ILIKE 'Insufficient'
                    AND t6.conservestatus ILIKE 'Critical'
            ) THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance AS t3 ON t1.artregistry = t3.artrefmaintained
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artrefconcerned
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artdynasty
)
SELECT 
    DAC.Dynasty,
    DAC.TotalPriorityScore,
    DAC.AdequateFundingCount,
    DAC.InsufficientFundingCount,
    DAC.BudgetEfficiencyValue,
    BS.BudgetStatus
FROM 
    DynastyArtifactCounts AS DAC
JOIN 
    BudgetStatus AS BS ON DAC.Dynasty = BS.Dynasty
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'ALL DYNASTIES',
    SUM(DAC.TotalPriorityScore),
    SUM(DAC.AdequateFundingCount),
    SUM(DAC.InsufficientFundingCount),
    AVG(DAC.BudgetEfficiencyValue),
    MAX(CASE WHEN BS.BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END)
FROM 
    DynastyArtifactCounts AS DAC
JOIN 
    BudgetStatus AS BS ON DAC.Dynasty = BS.Dynasty;

WITH market_operational_stability AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.mktregistry, 
        t1.mktdenom, 
        t1.mktclass, 
        -- Calculate Operational Security Index (OSI)
        (
            (t2.APL * 0.5) + 
            (t2.SPS * 0.2) + 
            (t2.tornodecount * 2) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Standard' THEN 1 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Custom' THEN 3 
                    ELSE 0
                END * 5
            ) - 
            (t2.iptally * 0.5)
        ) AS operational_stability_score,
        -- Calculate Market Risk Score (MRS)
        (
            (t1.dlyflow / 1000) + 
            (t1.esccomprate * 0.2) + 
            (t1.interscore * 0.3) + 
            (t1.vendcount * 0.1) - 
            (t1.mktspan / 100)
        ) AS market_risk_score,
        -- Extract fields from market_status_reputation JSONB column
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'status')::text AS status,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'trust_level')::text AS trust_level,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'reputation_score')::numeric AS reputation_score,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'community_trust_score')::numeric AS community_trust_score,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'dispute_resolution_score')::numeric AS dispute_resolution_score,
        -- Set compliance metrics to zero disputes
        jsonb_build_object(
            'rule_break_count', 0,
            'warning_count', 0,
            'penalty_count', 0,
            'restriction_level', 'None'
        ) AS compliance_metrics
    FROM 
        markets AS t1
    JOIN 
        (
            SELECT 
                secmonregistry, 
                -- Calculate Anonymity Protection Level (APL)
                (
                    (vpnflag_numeric * 30) + 
                    (tornodecount * 2) + 
                    (encryptmethod_numeric * 15) + 
                    (connpatscore * 0.2) + 
                    (brwsrunique / 20)
                ) AS APL,
                -- Calculate Security Posture Score (SPS)
                (
                    (100 - (vulntally * 5)) + 
                    (securitymeasurecount * 2) + 
                    (sessionsecurityscore * 0.5) + 
                    (privprotscore * 0.3) - 
                    (fpprob * 100)
                ) AS SPS,
                iptally, tornodecount, encryptmethod, vpnflag_numeric, brwsrunique, connpatscore,
                vulntally, securitymeasurecount, sessionsecurityscore, privprotscore, fpprob
            FROM 
                (
                    SELECT 
                        secmonregistry, iptally, tornodecount, encryptmethod, vpnflag,
                        brwsrunique, connpatscore, vulntally, securitymeasurecount, sessionsecurityscore,
                        privprotscore, fpprob,
                        -- Map vpnflag to numeric values
                        CASE vpnflag 
                            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 
                            WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS vpnflag_numeric,
                        -- Map encryptmethod to numeric values
                        CASE encryptmethod 
                            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
                            WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
                            WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS encryptmethod_numeric
                    FROM 
                        securitymonitoring
                ) AS t2
        ) AS t2
    ON 
        t1.mktregistry = t2.secmonregistry
),
ranked_markets AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry, 
        mktdenom, 
        mktclass, 
        operational_stability_score, 
        market_risk_score, 
        status, 
        trust_level,

WITH market_operational_stability AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.mktregistry, 
        t1.mktdenom, 
        t1.mktclass, 
        -- Calculate Operational Security Index (OSI)
        (
            (t2.APL * 0.5) + 
            (t2.SPS * 0.2) + 
            (t2.tornodecount * 2) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Standard' THEN 1 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
                    WHEN t2.encryptmethod = 'Custom' THEN 3 
                    ELSE 0
                END * 5
            ) - 
            (t2.inctally * 0.5)
        ) AS operational_stability_score,
        -- Calculate Market Risk Score (MRS)
        (
            (t1.dlyflow / 1000) + 
            (t1.esccomprate * 0.2) + 
            (t1.interscore * 0.3) + 
            (t1.vendcount * 0.1) - 
            (t1.mktspan / 100)
        ) AS market_risk_score,
        -- Extract fields from market_status_reputation JSONB column
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'status')::text AS status,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'trust_level')::text AS trust_level,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'reputation_score')::numeric AS reputation_score,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'community_trust_score')::numeric AS community_trust_score,
        (
            market_status_reputation ->> 'dispute_resolution_score')::numeric AS dispute_resolution_score,
        -- Set compliance metrics to zero disputes
        jsonb_build_object(
            'rule_break_count', 0,
            'warning_count', 0,
            'penalty_count', 0,
            'restriction_level', 'None'
        ) AS compliance_metrics
    FROM 
        markets AS t1
    JOIN 
        (
            SELECT 
                secmonregistry, 
                -- Calculate Anonymity Protection Level (APL)
                (
                    (vpnflag_numeric * 30) + 
                    (tornodecount * 2) + 
                    (encryptmethod_numeric * 15) + 
                    (connpatscore * 0.2) + 
                    (brwsrunique / 20)
                ) AS APL,
                -- Calculate Security Posture Score (SPS)
                (
                    (100 - (vulntally * 5)) + 
                    (securitymeasurecount * 2) + 
                    (sessionsecurityscore * 0.5) + 
                    (privprotscore * 0.3) - 
                    (fpprob * 100)
                ) AS SPS,
                inctally, tornodecount, encryptmethod, vpnflag_numeric, brwsrunique, connpatscore,
                vulntally, securitymeasurecount, sessionsecurityscore, privprotscore, fpprob
            FROM 
                (
                    SELECT 
                        secmonregistry, inctally, tornodecount, encryptmethod, vpnflag,
                        brwsrunique, connpatscore, vulntally, securitymeasurecount, sessionsecurityscore,
                        privprotscore, fpprob,
                        -- Map vpnflag to numeric values
                        CASE vpnflag 
                            WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 
                            WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS vpnflag_numeric,
                        -- Map encryptmethod to numeric values
                        CASE encryptmethod 
                            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
                            WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
                            WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END AS encryptmethod_numeric
                    FROM 
                        securitymonitoring
                ) AS t2
        ) AS t2
    ON 
        t1.mktregistry = t2.secmonregistry
),
ranked_markets AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry, 
        mktdenom, 
        mktclass, 
        operational_stability_score,

    FROM

)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref CHARACTER)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
DECLARE
    content_safety_score NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Calculate content safety score using various scores from different tables
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(sd.detection_score_profile->>'confval', 0)::NUMERIC * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ma.coordscore, 0) * 0.15
        + COALESCE((nm.network_engagement_metrics->'engagement_metrics'->>'engauth')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(cb.cntuniqscore, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(msa.convnatval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ti.iprepscore, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE((pr.profile_composition->>'completeness')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.05
        + COALESCE(ma.trustval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ma.impactval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE((sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.05
    INTO content_safety_score
    FROM 
        contentbehavior cb
    LEFT JOIN securitydetection sd ON cb.cntref = sd.secdetkey
    LEFT JOIN moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
    LEFT JOIN networkmetrics nm ON cb.cntsessref = nm.netsessref
    LEFT JOIN messaginganalysis msa ON cb.cntref = msa.msgcntref
    LEFT JOIN technicalinfo ti ON cb.cntref = ti.techkey
    LEFT JOIN profile pr ON cb.cntref = pr.profkey
    WHERE cb.cntref = p_cntref;

    -- Handle calculation errors
    IF content_safety_score IS NULL THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN content_safety_score;
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH eccs AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg(esi) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg(esi) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS avg_scanning_suitability
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT 
            (
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 OR se.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 OR se.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 100
                        WHEN se.illumelux BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 75
                        ELSE 50
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    CASE

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_performance_alert()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $ 
DECLARE 
BEGIN 
    -- Check if the new performance data indicates a critical alert
    IF (new.efficiency_profile->>'anndegrate')::NUMERIC > 0.7 THEN
        -- Check if a similar alert has been issued recently
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM alerts
            WHERE deviceref = new.solmodref
              AND alertstat = 'Critical'
              AND alertmoment > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
        ) THEN
            -- Update the existing alert
            UPDATE alerts
            SET alertmoment = NOW(),
                alertcnt = alertcnt + 1
            WHERE deviceref = new.solmodref
              AND alertstat = 'Critical'
              AND alertmoment = (
                SELECT MAX(alertmoment)
                FROM alerts
                WHERE deviceref = new.solmodref
                  AND alertstat = 'Critical'
            );
        ELSE
            -- Insert a new critical alert
            INSERT INTO alerts (
                alertreg,
                compreg,
                deviceref,
                incidentref,
                alertmoment,
                alertstat,
                alertcnt
            )
            VALUES (
                uuid_generate_v4(),
                (SELECT growregistry FROM panel WHERE panemark = new.solmodref),
                new.solmodref,
                new.perfregistry,
                NOW(),
                'Critical',
                1
            );
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN new;
END;
$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Create a trigger to call the function after inserting new performance data
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_performance_alert
AFTER INSERT ON performance
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION generate_performance_alert();

WITH rotation_schedule AS (
    SELECT 
        s.artregistry AS artifact_id,
        s.artname AS artifact_name,
        s.mattype AS material_type,
        u.displaydurmonths AS current_display_duration,
        -- Calculate DSD
        (36 * (10 - sens.lightsensitivity) * (10 - sens.tempsensitivity) * (10 - sens.humiditysensitivity)) / 1000 AS display_limit,
        -- Calculate ERPS
        ((
            (36 * (10 - sens.lightsensitivity) * (10 - sens.tempsensitivity) * (10 - sens.humiditysensitivity)) / 1000
            - u.displaydurmonths
        ) * (
            (l.lightlux * sens.lightsensitivity * l.visibleexplxh) / 1000 + 1
        ) * (
            (
                (r.histsignrating + r.researchvalrating + r.cultscore)
                * (10 - CASE s.conservestatus
                    WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
                END)
            ) / 30 + 1
        )) / 100 AS calculated_score,
        -- Determine recommendation based on ERPS
        CASE 
            WHEN ((
                (36 * (10 - sens.lightsensitivity) * (10 - sens.tempsensitivity) * (10 - sens.humiditysensitivity)) / 1000
                - u.displaydurmonths
            ) * (
                (l.lightlux * sens.lightsensitivity * l.visibleexplxh) / 1000 + 1
            ) * (
                (
                    (r.histsignrating + r.researchvalrating + r.cultscore)
                    * (10 - CASE s.conservestatus
                        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
                        WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
                        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
                        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
                        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END)
                ) / 30 + 1
            )) / 100 <= 50 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
            ELSE 'Monitor'
        END AS recommendation
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS s
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS u ON s.artregistry = u.artrefused
    JOIN 
        artifactratings AS r ON s.artregistry = r.artref
    JOIN 
        riskassessments AS risk ON s.artregistry = risk.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        lightandradiationreadings AS l ON l.envreadref = l.envreadref
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore AS e ON l.envreadref = e.envreadregistry
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments AS c ON e.envreadregistry = c.lightreadrefobserved
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS sens ON s.artregistry = sens.artref
    WHERE 
        u.displayrotatesched = 'Active'
)
SELECT * FROM rotation_schedule;

        containlink,

        MAX(tempnowc) AS max_tempnowc
    FROM sensordata
    GROUP BY containlink
),

    SELECT 
        c.containregistry,
        sm.max_tempdevcount,
        sm.max_critevents,

SELECT 
    cm.containregistry AS container_id,
    cm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temperature_stability_score,
    -- Assuming Container Risk Index is calculated based on critical events and temperature deviations
    (cm.max_critevents * 10 + cm.max_tempdevcount) AS container_risk_index,
    -- Assuming Risk Rank is based on the Container Risk Index
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cm.max_critevents * 10 + cm.max_tempdevcount) DESC) AS risk_rank,
    -- Assuming sensor data status is based on the presence of critical events
    CASE WHEN cm.max_critevents > 0 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sensor_data_status,
    -- Diagnostic JSON summary
    json_build_object(
        'TempDevCount', cm.max_tempdevcount,
        'CritEvents', cm.max_critevents,
        'TempStabIdx', cm.max_tempstabidx,
        'CoolRemainPct', cm.coolremainpct,
        -- Assuming Temperature Breach Severity is based on max_tempnowc
        'TempBreachSeverity', CASE WHEN cm.max_tempnowc > 0 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM ContainerMetrics cm
ORDER BY risk_rank
LIMIT 10;

    SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    ROUND(CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.facetverts / sm.facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
    m.mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
JOIN 
    (SELECT zoneref, 'High Quality' AS mesh_quality FROM scanmesh WHERE uvmapqual = 'High'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT zoneref, 'Standard Quality' AS mesh_quality FROM scanmesh WHERE uvmapqual <> 'High') m
ON 
    s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
GROUP BY 
    s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, m.mesh_quality
ORDER BY 
    site_code DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_market_risk(
    dlyflow BIGINT,
    esccomprate NUMERIC,
    interscore NUMERIC,
    vendcount INTEGER,
    mktspan INTEGER
)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
    (dlyflow / 1000.0) + (esccomprate * 0.2) + (interscore * 0.3) + (vendcount * 0.1) - (mktspan / 100.0)

SELECT
    t1.devregistry AS registry_id,
    t2.durabilityscore AS durability_score,
    t2.dustres AS dust_resistance_length,
    t2.waterres AS water_resistance_length,
    t2.bendforce AS bend_force,
    (
        t2.durabilityscore * (
            1 + (
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN t2.dustres ILIKE 'IPX0' THEN 0
                        WHEN t2.dustres ILIKE 'IPX1' THEN 1
                        WHEN t2.dustres ILIKE 'IPX2' THEN 2
                        WHEN t2.dustres ILIKE 'IPX3' THEN 3
                    END
                ) + (
                    CASE
                        WHEN t2.waterres ILIKE 'IPX0' THEN 0
                        WHEN t2.waterres ILIKE 'IPX1' THEN 1
                        WHEN t2.waterres ILIKE 'IPX2' THEN 2
                        WHEN t2.waterres ILIKE 'IPX3' THEN 3
                    END
                )
            ) / 6
        )
    ) * (
        1 - (
            (100 - t2.bendforce) / 200
        )
    ) AS per_value
FROM
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN
    interactionandcontrol AS t3 ON t1.devregistry = t3.interactdevref
JOIN
    physicaldurability AS t2 ON t3.interactphysref = t2.physregistry
ORDER BY
    per_value DESC;

WITH peer_corr_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        tradekind, 
        AVG(t1.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_peercorr,

    FROM 
        advancedbehavior AS t1
),
peer_corr_z_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.abhvreg, 
        t1.peercorr, 
        t2.avg_peercorr, 
        t2.stddev_peercorr, 
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.stddev_peercorr = 0 OR t2.stddev_peercorr IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE (t1.peercorr - t2.avg_peercorr) / t2.stddev_peercorr 
        END AS peer_corr_z_score
    FROM 
        advancedbehavior AS t1
    JOIN 
        peer_corr_stats AS t2 ON t1.tradekind = t2.tradekind
)

    abhvreg, 
    peer_corr_z_score
FROM 
    peer_corr_z_scores;

        (CASE

            ELSE 0
        END) +
        (CASE 
            WHEN se.ambictemp < 0 THEN 1

            ELSE 0

        (CASE

            WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 3
            WHEN se.humepct > 60 THEN 5
            ELSE 0

        (CASE

            WHEN se.illumelux BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000 THEN 3
            WHEN se.illumelux > 50000 THEN 5
            ELSE 0

        (CASE

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $ $
DECLARE
    market_factor DECIMAL;
BEGIN
    -- Get the current market factor
    SELECT mkteffect INTO market_factor
    FROM systemmonitoring
    ORDER BY systemmonitoringpivot DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Calculate MIC for new orders and log the values
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic, calculated_at)
    SELECT
        o.recordvault,
        (o.notionsum * market_factor) AS calculated_mic,
        NOW()
    FROM
        orders o
    WHERE
        o.orderflow = 'New';
END;
$ $

CREATE TABLE market_impact_cost_log (
    log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ordersmark TEXT,
    mic NUMERIC,
    calculated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

    COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS insufficient_funding_count,
    AVG(cm.maintbudgetstatus) AS budget_efficiency_value,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) > 0

CREATE TABLE high_risk_transactions AS
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ra.moneyrisk,
    ra.txchainlen,
    ra.wallbalusd,
    ra.wallturnrt,
    ra.txvel,
    ra.idverifyscore,
    (
        (t.payamtusd / 1000) * 
        (t.txfinishhrs / 24) * 
        (1 + (t.escrowhrs / 100)) * 
        (1 - (m.esccomprate / 100))
    ) AS tas,
    (
        (ra.txchainlen * 10) + 
        (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + 
        (ra.fraudprob * 100) - 
        (ra.profilecomplete * 0.5) - 
        (ra.idverifyscore * 0.5)
    ) AS tcr,
    (
        (COUNT(t.txregistry) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref)) / 
        (MAX(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref) - 
        MIN(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref))
    ) * (
        t.payamtusd / 500
    ) * (
        1 + (
            CASE t.paymethod
                WHEN 'Crypto_A' THEN 1
                WHEN 'Crypto_B' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Crypto_C' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Token' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END * 0.1
        )
    ) AS tvm
FROM 
    riskanalysis ra
JOIN 
    transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN 
    markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE 
    ra.moneyrisk = 'High';

WITH treatment_adherence AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey AS facility_id,
        TO_JSONB(f.support_and_resources) AS support_resources,
        tx.medadh AS medication_adherence,
        txo.txadh AS treatment_adherence
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        clinicians c ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
    JOIN 
        patients p ON c.clinkey = p.clinleadref
    JOIN 
        encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
    JOIN 
        treatmentbasics tx ON e.enckey = tx.encref
    JOIN 
        treatmentoutcomes txo ON tx.txkey = txo.txref
),
resource_adequacy AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        (
            support_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate'
        )::INT AS resource_adequacy_score
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence
),
treatment_adherence_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN medication_adherence = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN medication_adherence = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS med_adh_rate,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN treatment_adherence = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN treatment_adherence = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS treat_adh_rate
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence
    GROUP BY 
        facility_id
),
overall_support_index AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        AVG(
            resource_adequacy_score + med_adh_rate + treat_adh_rate
        ) AS osi
    FROM 
        resource_adequacy ra
    JOIN 
        treatment_adherence_rate tar ON ra.facility_id = tar.facility_id
    GROUP BY 
        facility_id
)
SELECT 
    CORR(
        osi, 
        treat_adh_rate
    ) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM 
    overall_support_index osi
JOIN 
    treatment_adherence_rate tar ON osi.facility_id = tar.facility_id;

CREATE TABLE high_risk_transactions AS
SELECT 
    ra.riskregistry,
    ra.moneyrisk,
    ra.txchainlen,
    ra.wallbalusd,
    ra.wallturnrt,
    ra.txvel,
    ra.idverifyscore,
    (
        (t.payamtusd / 1000) * 
        (t.txfinishhrs / 24) * 
        (1 + (t.escrowhrs / 100)) * 
        (1 - (m.esccomprate / 100))
    ) AS tas,
    (
        (ra.txchainlen * 10) + 
        (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + 
        (ra.fraudprob * 100) - 
        (ra.profilecomplete * 0.5) - 
        (ra.idverifyscore * 0.5)
    ) AS tcr,
    (
        (COUNT(t.txregistry) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref)) / 
        (MAX(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref) - 
        MIN(t.eventstamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.buyref))
    ) * (
        t.payamtusd / 500
    ) * (
        1 + (
            CASE t.paymethod
                WHEN 'Crypto_A' THEN 1
                WHEN 'Crypto_B' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Crypto_C' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Token' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END * 0.1
        )
    ) AS tvm
FROM 
    riskanalysis ra
JOIN 
    transactions t ON ra.txref = t.txregistry
JOIN 
    markets m ON t.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE 
    ra.moneyrisk = 'High';

WITH treatment_adherence AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey AS facility_id,
        TO_JSONB(f.support_and_resources) AS support_resources,
        tx.medadh AS medication_adherence,
        txo.txadh AS treatment_adherence
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        clinicians c ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
    JOIN 
        patients p ON c.clinkey = p.clinleadref
    JOIN 
        encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
    JOIN

    JOIN 
        treatmentoutcomes txo ON tx.txkey = txo.txref
),
resource_adequacy AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        (
            support_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate'
        )::INT AS resource_adequacy_score
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence
),
treatment_adherence_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN medication_adherence = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN medication_adherence = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS med_adh_rate,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN treatment_adherence = 'High' THEN 1
                WHEN treatment_adherence = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS treat_adh_rate
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence
    GROUP BY 
        facility_id
),
overall_support_index AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.facility_id,
        AVG(
            resource_adequacy_score + med_adh_rate + treat_adh_rate
        ) AS osi
    FROM 
        resource_adequacy ra
    JOIN 
        treatment_adherence_rate tar ON ra.facility_id = tar.facility_id
    GROUP BY 
        ra.facility_id
)
SELECT 
    CORR(
        osi.osi, 
        tar.treat_adh_rate
    ) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM 
    overall_support_index osi
JOIN 
    treatment_adherence_rate tar ON osi.facility_id = tar.facility_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(
    txkey INT
)
RETURNS FLOAT AS $ $
DECLARE
    total_engagement_score FLOAT;
    total_sessions INT;
BEGIN
    -- Fetch the therapy details for the given treatment
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                ELSE 0 -- Default case for any unexpected values
            END
        ) AS total_score,
        COUNT(*) AS session_count
    INTO
        total_engagement_score,
        total_sessions
    FROM
        treatmentbasics
    WHERE
        txkey = txkey;

    -- Calculate the average engagement score
    IF total_sessions > 0 THEN
        RETURN total_engagement_score / total_sessions;
    ELSE
        RETURN 0; -- Return 0 if no sessions found
    END IF;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trader_omi_distribution(trader_ref VARCHAR)
RETURNS TABLE (trader_id VARCHAR, transaction_count INT, omi_mean FLOAT, omi_stddev FLOAT, omi_min FLOAT, omi_max FLOAT)
AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        t.tradereg AS trader_id,
        COUNT(tr.transreg) AS transaction_count,
        AVG(tr.modfreq) AS omi_mean,
        STDDEV(tr.modfreq) AS omi_stddev,
        MIN(tr.modfreq) AS omi_min,
        MAX(tr.modfreq) AS omi_max
    FROM
        trader t
    JOIN
        transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    WHERE
        t.tradereg = trader_ref
    GROUP BY
        t.tradereg;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH EquipmentCount AS (

    LEFT JOIN

    GROUP BY

),
RenewableData AS (
    SELECT 
        tswg.thermalpowerref,
        SUM(rm.wind.output_w) AS total_wind_output,
        SUM(rm.solar.output_w) AS total_solar_output
    FROM 
        thermalsolarwindandgrid AS tswg
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::renewablemetrics, tswg.renewablemetrics) AS rm
    WHERE 
        rm.wind IS NOT NULL OR rm.solar IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 
        tswg.thermalpowerref
),
PowerData AS (
    SELECT 
        pb.powerbattregistry,
        pb.powersource,
        pb.powerconsumptionw
    FROM 
        powerbattery AS pb
),
LocationWithEquipment AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationtype,
        l.stationname,
        ec.equipment_count,
        pd.powersource,
        pd.powerconsumptionw,
        rd.total_wind_output,
        rd.total_solar_output,
        (rd.total_wind_output + rd.total_solar_output) AS total_renewable_power,
        ek.definition AS energy_classification
    FROM 
        location AS l
    JOIN 
        EquipmentCount AS ec ON l.locationregistry = ec.locationregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        PowerData AS pd ON l.locationregistry = pd.powerbattregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        RenewableData AS rd ON pd.powerbattregistry = rd.thermalpowerref
    LEFT JOIN 
        external_knowledge AS ek ON pd.powersource = ek.external_knowledge_name
)

WITH ArticleMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        catlabel AS article_category,
        -- Calculate ARS using the provided formula
        (readsec * LN(wordlen)) / 
        CASE 
            WHEN difflevel = 'Basic' THEN 1
            WHEN difflevel = 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
            WHEN difflevel = 'Advanced' THEN 2
            ELSE 1.2 
        END AS readability_score,
        -- Extract engagement rate from JSON
        (engagement_metrics->>'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate,
        difflevel AS complexity_level
    FROM 
        articles
),
ComplexityCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        complexity_level, 
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        ArticleMetrics
    GROUP BY 
        complexity_level
),
AverageMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        AVG(readability_score) AS avg_readability_score,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate
    FROM 
        ArticleMetrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
),
CorrelationMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        CORR(readability_score, engagement_rate) AS correlation_coefficient
    FROM 
        ArticleMetrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
)
SELECT 
    am.article_category,
    am.avg_readability_score,
    am.avg_engagement_rate,
    cm.correlation_coefficient,
    cc.article_count
FROM 
    AverageMetrics am
JOIN 
    CorrelationMetrics cm ON am.article_category = cm.article_category
JOIN 
    ComplexityCounts cc ON am.article_category = cc.complexity_level
GROUP BY 
    am.article_category, am.avg_readability_score, am.avg_engagement_rate, cm.correlation_coefficient, cc.article_count;

        assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON a.abkey = asr.asrkey
    WHERE 
        asr.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_severity' = 'Severe'
        OR asr.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_severity' = 'Severe'
    GROUP BY 
        f.fackey
),
facility_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey,
        (f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources')::NUMERIC AS frai,
        AVG((asr.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::NUMERIC) AS pfis
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        encounters e ON f.fackey = e.facid
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics a ON e.abref = a.abkey
    JOIN 
        assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON a.abkey = asr.asrkey
    GROUP BY 
        f.fackey
)

FROM

JOIN 
    facility_metrics fm ON hrc.fackey = fm.fackey
WHERE 
    hrc.high_risk_prevalence > 20
ORDER BY

WITH UserMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        typelabel AS subscription_type,
        seglabel AS demographic_segment,
        ageval AS age,
        gendlbl AS gender,
        occulbl AS occupation,
        testgrp AS ab_test_group,
        (subdays * 0.1) + (ageval * 0.2) + 
        CASE gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.3 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.2 
        END + 
        CASE occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.15 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_subscription_value,
        (ageval * 0.3) + 
        CASE gendlbl 
            WHEN 'M' THEN 0.2 
            WHEN 'F' THEN 0.25 
            ELSE 0.15 
        END + 
        CASE occulbl 
            WHEN 'Professional' THEN 0.25 
            WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.1 
            ELSE 0.1 
        END AS user_demographic_score
    FROM users
),
GroupedMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        subscription_type,
        demographic_segment,
        AVG(user_subscription_value) AS avg_usv,
        AVG(user_demographic_score) AS avg_uds,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count
    FROM UserMetrics
    GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment
)
SELECT 
    subscription_type,
    demographic_segment,
    avg_usv,
    avg_uds,
    string_agg(interests, ', ' ORDER BY interests) AS shared_interests,
    user_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        gm.subscription_type,
        gm.demographic_segment,
        gm.avg_usv,
        gm.avg_uds,
        um.interests,
        gm.user_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gm.subscription_type, gm.demographic_segment ORDER BY gm.user_count DESC) AS row_num
    FROM GroupedMetrics gm
    JOIN UserMetrics um ON gm.subscription_type = um.subscription_type AND gm.demographic_segment = um.demographic_segment
) ranked
WHERE row_num = 1
GROUP BY subscription_type, demographic_segment, avg_usv, avg_uds, user_count
ORDER BY user_count DESC;

WITH PriceChanges AS (

        (ms.priceshiftday * 100 / ms.openstake) AS avg_price_change_24h,
        ((ms.highspotday - ms.lowspotday) * 100 / ms.lowspotday) AS avg_price_change_4h,
        ((md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'askquote')::numeric - (md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'bidquote')::numeric) * 100 / (md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'bidquote')::numeric AS avg_price_change_1h
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        marketdata md ON o.mktnote = md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'mktcombo'
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON o.mktnote = ms.mdlink
),
SmartTradingSuccessRate AS (
    SELECT 
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'flowimbal' AS flow_category,
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'whalemotion' AS whale_driven_market_activity,
        pc.market_pair,
        pc.avg_price_change_1h,
        pc.avg_price_change_4h,
        pc.avg_price_change_24h,
        (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'smartforce')::numeric / (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'retailflow')::numeric AS smart_trading_success_rate
    FROM 
        analyticsindicators ai
    JOIN 
        marketdata md ON ai.mdataref = md.marketdatanode
    JOIN 
        PriceChanges pc ON md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'mktcombo' = pc.market_pair

WITH sensitivity_weights AS (
    SELECT 
        artref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN envsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS env_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS light_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS temp_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS humidity_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS vibra_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS pollutant_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS pest_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS handle_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS transport_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS display_weight, 
        CASE 
            WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
        END AS storage_weight
    FROM sensitivitydata
),
risk_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry, 
        a.artname, 
        (
            sw.env_weight + sw.light_weight + sw.temp_weight + sw.humidity_weight + 
            sw.vibra_weight + sw.pollutant_weight + sw.pest_weight + sw.handle_weight + 
            sw.transport_weight + sw.display_weight + sw.storage_weight
        ) / 11.0 AS risk_score, 
        json_build_object(
            'envsensitivity', sw.env_weight,
            'lightsensitivity', sw.light_weight,
            'tempsensitivity', sw.temp_weight,
            'humiditysensitivity', sw.humidity_weight,
            'vibrasensitivity', sw.vibra_weight,
            'pollutantsensitivity', sw.pollutant_weight,
            'pestsensitivity', sw.pest_weight,
            'handlesensitivity', sw.handle_weight,
            'transportsensitivity', sw.transport_weight,
            'displaysensitivity', sw.display_weight,
            'storagesensitivity', sw.storage_weight
        ) AS sensitivity_ratings
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN sensitivity_weights sw ON a.artregistry = sw.artref
)
SELECT 
    artregistry,

    risk_score, 
    sensitivity_ratings
FROM risk_scores
WHERE risk_score > 7
ORDER BY risk_score DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_credit_score(
    customer_score NUMERIC,
    credit_utilization_ratio NUMERIC,
    debt_ratio NUMERIC,
    credit_age_years INT,
    delinquency_count INT,
    late_payment_count INT,
    charge_offs INT,
    bankruptcies INT
) RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        customer_score * (1 - credit_utilization_ratio) * (1 - debt_ratio)
        * (credit_age_years + 1) / (delinquency_count + late_payment_count + charge_offs + bankruptcies + 1)
    );
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

    FROM

    JOIN

    ON
        p.effectivenessoperation = o.operreg

robot_avg_eer AS (

    FROM
        robot_eer
    GROUP BY
        application_type
),
robot_rank_eer AS (
    SELECT
        application_type,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY eer) AS eer_rank
    FROM
        robot_eer
    GROUP BY
        application_type
)
SELECT

    a.average_eer,
    r.eer_rank
FROM

JOIN

ON
    a.application_type = r.application_type

WITH robot_eer AS (
    SELECT
        o.apptypeval AS application_type,
        p.energyusekwhval AS energy_usage,
        o.totopshrval AS total_operating_hours,
        (p.energyusekwhval / o.totopshrval) AS eer
    FROM
        performance_and_safety AS p
    JOIN
        operation AS o
    ON
        p.effectivenessoperation = o.operreg
),
robot_avg_eer AS (
    SELECT
        application_type,
        AVG(eer) AS average_eer
    FROM
        robot_eer
    GROUP BY
        application_type
),
robot_rank_eer AS (
    SELECT
        application_type,
        eer,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY eer) AS eer_rank
    FROM
        robot_eer
    GROUP BY
        application_type, eer
)
SELECT
    a.application_type,
    a.average_eer,
    r.eer_rank
FROM
    robot_avg_eer AS a
JOIN
    robot_rank_eer AS r
ON
    a.application_type = r.application_type
ORDER BY
    eer_rank;

            ) * 3.0
        ) / 3.0
    FROM 
        contentbehavior
    LEFT JOIN 
        moderationaction ON contentbehavior.cntref = moderationaction.macntref
    LEFT JOIN 
        securitydetection ON moderationaction.masedetref = securitydetection.secdetkey
    LEFT JOIN 
        networkmetrics ON contentbehavior.cntsessref = networkmetrics.netsessref
    LEFT JOIN 
        messaginganalysis ON contentbehavior.cntref = messaginganalysis.msgcntref
    LEFT JOIN

    LEFT JOIN 
        profile ON contentbehavior.cntsessref = profile.profkey

        contentbehavior.cntref = p_cntref

    registration_month, ab_test_group
ORDER BY 
    registration_month, ab_test_group;

    sr.logaccumm AS accuracy_measurements,
    sr.errvalmm AS error_values,
    (sr.logaccumm / sr.errvalmm) AS calculated_ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN (sr.logaccumm / sr.errvalmm) > 1.5 THEN 'High Confidence' 
        WHEN (sr.logaccumm / sr.errvalmm) BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence' 
        ELSE 'Low Confidence' 
    END AS confidence_level
FROM 
    scanregistration AS sr
JOIN 
    projects AS p ON sr.arcref = p.arcregistry;

SELECT 
    devregistry AS device_registry_id,
    (
        (wlrangem / 10.0) * 
        (1 - wllatvar / 5.0) * 
        (1 + CASE WHEN wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END / 2.0) * 
        ((wlsignal + 100) / 100.0)
    ) AS wireless_performance_rating
FROM 
    deviceidentity
WHERE 
    (
        (wlrangem / 10.0) * 
        (1 - wllatvar / 5.0) * 
        (1 + CASE WHEN wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END / 2.0) * 
        ((wlsignal + 100) / 100.0)
    ) > 8.5;

SELECT 
    p.patkey AS patient_id,
    a.abkey AS assessment_id,
    e.timemark AS most_recent_assessment_date,
    ROUND(AVG(asd.strslvl)) AS average_rounded_TES_score,
    f.envstress AS site_stress_indicator
FROM 
    patients p
JOIN 
    encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics a ON e.abref = a.abkey
JOIN 
    assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON a.abkey = asd.asdkey
JOIN 
    facilities f ON e.facid = f.fackey
JOIN 
    treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        patref, 
        MAX(timemark) as max_date
    FROM 
        encounters
    GROUP BY 
        patref
) recent ON e.patref = recent.patref AND e.timemark = recent.max_date
WHERE 
    f.envstress = 'High'
    AND tb.therapy_details->>'engagement' = 'Weak'
GROUP BY 
    p.patkey, a.abkey, e.timemark, f.envstress
ORDER BY 
    e.timemark DESC
LIMIT 10;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(txkey INT)
RETURNS INT AS $ $
DECLARE 
    engagement_rating TEXT;
    engagement_score INT;
BEGIN
    -- Get the engagement rating from the therapy details
    SELECT therapy_details ->> 'engagement' INTO engagement_rating
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE txkey = txkey;
    
    -- Map the engagement rating to a score
    CASE engagement_rating
        WHEN 'High' THEN engagement_score = 3
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN engagement_score = 2
        WHEN 'Low' THEN engagement_score = 1
        WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN engagement_score = 0
        ELSE engagement_score = NULL -- Handle unknown ratings
    END CASE;
    
    -- Return the engagement score
    RETURN engagement_score;
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW therapy_engagement_score AS
SELECT 
    txkey,
    (
        CASE 
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
            ELSE NULL -- Handle unknown ratings
        END
    ) AS tes
FROM treatmentbasics;

    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        operation op ON ps.effectivenessoperation = op.operreg
    WHERE 
        ps.conditionindexval > 1.5 
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
),
regression_slopes AS (
    SELECT 
        qr.robot_id, 
        SUM(qr.jdi * qr.toh) AS sum_xy, 
        SUM(qr.jdi) AS sum_y, 
        SUM(qr.toh) AS sum_x, 
        SUM(qr.toh * qr.toh) AS sum_x_squared, 
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM 
        qualifying_robots qr
    GROUP BY 
        qr.robot_id
),
robot_details AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, 
        rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series, 
        rd.bottypeval AS robot_type, 
        rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity, 
        rd.reachmmval AS reach_mm, 
        rd.instdateval AS installation_date, 
        rd.fwversionval AS firmware_version, 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
)
SELECT 
    rd.robot_id, 
    rd.manufacturer, 
    rd.model_series, 
    rd.robot_type, 
    rd.payload_capacity, 
    rd.reach_mm, 
    rd.installation_date, 
    rd.firmware_version, 
    rd.controller_type, 
    (rs.n * rs.sum_xy - rs.sum_x * rs.sum_y) / (rs.n * rs.sum_x_squared - rs.sum_x * rs.sum_x) AS jdi_toh_slope
FROM 
    regression_slopes rs
JOIN 
    robot_details rd ON rs.robot_id = rd.robot_id
ORDER BY 
    rd.robot_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH SiteAverages AS (

        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.zoneref AS site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sc.curerank) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        scanconservation sc
),
EnvironmentalConditions AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN AVG(se.ambictemp) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS environmental_condition
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    ec.environmental_condition
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.site_code
LEFT JOIN 
    EnvironmentalConditions ec ON s.zoneregistry = ec.site_code;
