        AVG(
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -5 AND 40 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN -10 AND -5 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.ambictemp BETWEEN 40 AND 50 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 30 AND 70 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.humepct BETWEEN 70 AND 80 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 30000 AND 50000 THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.illumelux BETWEEN 10000 AND 30000 THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Good' THEN 75
                    WHEN t2.geosignal = 'Poor' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END

                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 100
                    WHEN t2.trackstatus = 'None' THEN 50
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) + 
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN t2.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 100

                    ELSE 0

CREATE VIEW esi_view AS
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.saferank AS safety_rank,
    s.entrystat AS entry_status,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_evaluation,
    s.healtheval AS health_evaluation,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_hazard,
    se.ambictemp AS ambient_temperature,
    se.humepct AS humidity_percentage,
    se.illumelux AS illumination_lux,
    se.geosignal AS gps_signal_quality,
    se.trackstatus AS rtk_status,
    se.linkstatus AS network_status,
    se.photomap AS photogrammetry_overlap,
    se.imgcount AS image_count,
    -- Calculate environmental score based on various criteria
    (
        -- Preservation status scoring
        CASE s.presstat 
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 4 
            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 0 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Safety rank scoring
        CASE s.saferank 
            WHEN 'Minimal' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'High' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 2 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Entry status scoring
        CASE s.entrystat 
            WHEN 'Closed' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Restricted' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Open' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Insurance status scoring
        CASE s.insurstat 
            WHEN 'Expired' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Pending' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Active' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Risk evaluation scoring
        CASE s.riskeval 
            WHEN 'Required' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Completed' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Pending' THEN 2 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Health evaluation scoring
        CASE s.healtheval 
            WHEN 'Approved' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Review' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Pending' THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Environmental hazard scoring
        CASE s.envhaz 
            WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'High' THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Ambient temperature scoring
        GREATEST(0, (30 - ABS(se.ambictemp - 20)) / 10) +
        -- Humidity percentage scoring
        GREATEST(0, (40 - ABS(se.humepct - 50)) / 10) +
        -- Illumination lux scoring
        GREATEST(0, (100 - ABS(se.illumelux - 50000)) / 1000) +
        -- GPS signal quality scoring
        CASE se.geosignal 
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0 
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- RTK status scoring
        CASE se.trackstatus 
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0 
            WHEN 'Fixed' THEN 2 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Network status scoring
        CASE se.linkstatus 
            WHEN 'Disconnected' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Connected' THEN 2 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Photogrammetry overlap scoring
        CASE se.photomap 
            WHEN '80%' THEN 3 
            WHEN '60%' THEN 2 
            WHEN '90%' THEN 4 
            ELSE 0 
        END +
        -- Image count scoring
        LEAST(se.imgcount / 100.0, 4)
    ) AS environmental_score
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanenvironment se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_market_risk(
    dlyflow BIGINT,
    esccomprate NUMERIC,
    interscore NUMERIC,
    vendcount INTEGER,
    mktspan INTEGER
)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
    (dlyflow / 1000.0) + (esccomprate * 0.2) + (interscore * 0.3) + (vendcount * 0.1) - (mktspan / 100.0)
$$ LANGUAGE SQL;

SELECT 
    upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
    -- Calculate maintenance priority based on fault data and remaining life
    (faultpredscore * 1000000 / (rulhours + 1)) AS maintenance_priority,
    faultpredscore AS fault_score,
    rulhours AS remaining_life,
    rects AS timestamp
FROM 
    maintenance_and_fault
JOIN 
    robot_record ON upkeeprobot = botcode
ORDER BY 
    maintenance_priority DESC;

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    encounter_id VARCHAR(30),
    patient_id VARCHAR(20),
    timestamp TIMESTAMP,
    reason TEXT
);

INSERT INTO audit_log (encounter_id, patient_id, timestamp, reason)
SELECT 
    e.enckey AS encounter_id,
    e.patref AS patient_id,
    e.timemark AS timestamp,
    CASE 
        WHEN a.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') THEN 'High or Severe suicide risk'
        WHEN a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score' > 15 THEN 'PHQ-9 score > 15'
        WHEN a.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score' > 15 THEN 'GAD-7 score > 15'
    END AS reason
FROM 
    encounters e
JOIN 
    patients p ON e.patref = p.patkey
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics ab ON p.patkey = ab.patownerref
JOIN 
    assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON ab.abkey = a.abkey
WHERE 
    (a.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') 
    OR a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score' > 15
    OR a.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score' > 15);

SELECT 
    upkeeprobot AS robot_id,
    -- Calculate maintenance priority based on fault data and remaining life
    (faultpredscore * 1000000 / (rulhours + 1)) AS maintenance_priority,
    faultpredscore AS fault_score,
    rulhours AS remaining_life,
    rects AS timestamp
FROM 
    maintenance_and_fault
JOIN 
    robot_details ON upkeeprobot = botdetreg
JOIN 
    robot_record ON botdetreg = recreg
ORDER BY 
    maintenance_priority DESC;

SELECT 
  financeregistry AS registry_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN fundingstate = 'Critical' THEN 'Financial Crisis Risk'
    ELSE 'Financially Stable'
  END AS status
FROM 
  financials
ORDER BY 
  financeregistry ASC;

SELECT
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    AVG((ps.safety_metrics->>'SIS')::int) AS avg_sis,
    MAX((ps.safety_metrics->>'SIS')::int) AS max_sis
FROM 
    performance_and_safety ps
JOIN 
    robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault mf ON ps.effectivenessrobot = mf.upkeeprobot
WHERE 
    mf.issuecategoryval = 'Safety'
GROUP BY 
    rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY 
    avg_sis DESC;

WITH pru_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.equipref, 
        (sp.flowhrs * (sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2.0) / (sp.remaingb * 10 * LN(sm.facetverts + 10000)) AS pru_value
    FROM 
        scanprocessing AS sp
    JOIN 
        scanmesh AS sm ON sp.equipref = sm.equipref
)
SELECT 
    e.equipregistry AS equipment_id,
    pc.pru_value,
    AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS avg_processing_time_hours,
    CASE 
        WHEN pc.pru_value < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized' 
        WHEN pc.pru_value < 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable' 
        ELSE 'Needs Optimization' 
    END AS efficiency_ranking,
    e.equipstatus AS workflow_status,
    CONCAT(e.equipform, ' - ', e.equipdesign, ' (', e.powerlevel, '%)') AS resource_details
FROM 
    pru_calc AS pc
JOIN 
    equipment AS e ON pc.equipref = e.equipregistry
JOIN 
    scanprocessing AS sp ON pc.equipref = sp.equipref
GROUP BY 
    e.equipregistry, pc.pru_value, e.equipstatus, e.equipform, e.equipdesign, e.powerlevel;

WITH SilentSupporters AS (
    SELECT 
        f.nicklabel AS nickname,
        f.statustag AS membership_tier,
        e.engrate AS engagement_rate,
        e.contpref AS content_preference_classification,
        (ms.spendusd * (1 + ms.membdays/365.0 * 0.5) * (1 + COALESCE(i.gifttot, 0)/10.0 * 0.2)) AS mv,
        (i.engagement_metrics->>'chatmsg')::float / (i.engagement_metrics->>'sessdurmin')::float AS chat_to_session_ratio
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON f.userregistry = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    JOIN
        membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
)
SELECT 
    nickname, 
    membership_tier, 
    engagement_rate, 
    content_preference_classification
FROM 
    SilentSupporters
WHERE 
    mv > 100 
    AND engagement_rate < 0.3
    AND chat_to_session_ratio < 0.5;

CREATE VIEW vw_panel_efficiency AS
SELECT 
    p.panemark AS panel_identifier,
    perf.measpoww AS performance,
    (
        perf.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct'
    )::NUMERIC AS calculated_metrics
FROM 
    panel AS p
JOIN 
    performance AS perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref;

SELECT
    t1.observstation,
    t1.lunarstage As current_moon_phase,
    AVG(t2.interflvl) As avg_interference_level,
    COUNT(t2.signalignaligregistry) As problematic_event_count
From
    observatories As t1
    Left Join signals As t2 On t1.observstation = t2.telescref
Group By t1.observstation
Order By avg_interference_level;

WITH ranked_patterns AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.riskregistry,
        ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' AS transaction_pattern_category,
        tam.anomaly_detection_score,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tam.anomaly_detection_score DESC) AS anomaly_rank
    FROM 
        riskanalysis AS ra
    JOIN 
        securitymonitoring AS sm ON ra.riskregistry = sm.riskref
    JOIN 
        communication AS com ON ra.commref = com.commregistry
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query_array(sm.threat_analysis_metrics, '$.anomaly_detection_score') AS tam(anomaly_detection_score)
    WHERE 
        ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' IN ('High-risk', 'Suspicious')
)
SELECT 
    riskregistry,
    transaction_pattern_category,
    anomaly_detection_score,
    anomaly_rank
FROM 
    ranked_patterns
ORDER BY 
    anomaly_rank;

UPDATE equipment AS e
SET reliabilityindex = reliabilityindex + 1
FROM cabinenvironment AS ce
JOIN (
    SELECT cabinregistry, cabinclimate
    FROM cabinenvironment
    WHERE (
        (cabinclimate->>'temperature_c')::DECIMAL BETWEEN 18 AND 24
        AND (cabinclimate->>'o2_percent')::DECIMAL > 19.5
        AND (cabinclimate->>'co2_ppm')::DECIMAL < 1000
        AND ventilationstatus ILIKE 'On'
        AND heaterstatus ILIKE 'On'
    )
) AS good_cabins ON ce.cabinregistry = good_cabins.cabinregistry
WHERE e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref;

    account AS a ON p.profaccref = a.accindex

    ma.clustsize

WITH normalized_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.abhvreg, 
        (ab.peercorr - AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)) / 
        NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind), 0) AS normalized_peer_score
    FROM 
        advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN 
        trader AS t ON ab.abhvreg = t.tradereg
)
SELECT 
    abhvreg, 
    COALESCE(normalized_peer_score, 0) AS new_normalized_peer_score
FROM 
    normalized_scores;

CREATE VIEW site_esi AS
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.zonelabel,
    (
        (CASE 
            WHEN s.presstat = 'Excellent' THEN 5
            WHEN s.presstat = 'Good' THEN 4
            WHEN s.presstat = 'Fair' THEN 3
            WHEN s.presstat = 'Poor' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END) +
        (CASE

CREATE TABLE market_impact_cost_log (
    log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ordersmark TEXT,
    mic NUMERIC,
    calculated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
AS $ $
DECLARE
    current_market_factor NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Get the current market factor
    SELECT mkteffect INTO current_market_factor
    FROM systemmonitoring
    ORDER BY systemmonitoringpivot DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Calculate MIC for new orders and log the values
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
    SELECT
        o.recordvault,
        (o.notionsum * current_market_factor) AS calculated_mic
    FROM
        orders o
    WHERE
        o.orderflow = 'New';
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

    (SUM(CASE WHEN sm.uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces / sm.facetverts) AS avg_complexity_ratio,

    signals AS s

    signaldynamics AS sd ON s.signalregistry = sd.signalref

    s.signalclass = 'Narrowband';

WITH DynastyBudget AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS DynastyName,
        SUM(r.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus = 'Available' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus != 'Available' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus = 'Available' THEN 1 END) < COUNT(CASE WHEN c.maintbudgetstatus != 'Available' THEN 1 END) 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        riskassessments r ON a.artregistry = r.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance c ON a.artregistry = c.artrefmaintained
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
SummaryBudget AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS DynastyName,
        SUM(TotalConservationPriorityIndex) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(AdequateFundingCount) < SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyBudget
)

WITH health_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        de.distregistry AS registry_id,
        (
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score
    FROM 
        disasterevents de
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON de.distregistry = eah.envdistref
),
health_crisis AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.registry_id,
        hs.health_resilience_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN eah.diseaserisk = 'High' 
            AND eah.waterqualityindex < 50 
            AND hs.health_resilience_score < 40 THEN 'Health Crisis'
            ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
        END AS health_status
    FROM 
        health_scores hs
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON hs.registry_id = eah.envdistref
)
SELECT

FROM

ORDER BY

            WHEN LAG((therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT) OVER (ORDER BY txkey) IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (
                CASE (therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT 
                    WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                    ELSE NULL
                END - 
                CASE LAG((therapy_details->>'engagement')::TEXT) OVER (ORDER BY txkey) 
                    WHEN 'High' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            )
        END AS engagement_variation
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE therapy_details->>'changes' IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    change_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
    AVG(engagement_variation) AS avg_engagement_variation
FROM engagement_changes
GROUP BY change_type
ORDER BY change_type;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(treatment_id INT)
RETURNS INT AS $ $
DECLARE
    engagement_rating INT;
BEGIN
    -- Extract the engagement rating from the therapy details JSONB column
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
            ELSE NULL
        END
    INTO engagement_rating
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE txkey = treatment_id;

    -- Return the engagement rating
    RETURN engagement_rating;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_record AS rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode
),
robot_precision AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.actdetref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN ad.poserrmmval >= 0.1 THEN 'Low/Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS precision_category
    FROM 
        actuation_data AS ad
),
robot_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
        AVG(ad.poserrmmval) AS avg_position_error, 
        MAX(ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
        AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_fault_prediction_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_age AS ra ON rd.botdetreg = ra.botdetreg
    JOIN 
        robot_precision AS rp ON rd.botdetreg = rp.actdetref
    JOIN 
        actuation_data AS ad ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actdetref
    JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    WHERE 
        rp.precision_category = 'Low/Medium' 
        AND ra.ray > 1
    GROUP BY 
        rd.ctrltypeval
)
SELECT

FROM

    a.acctcategory,
    a.authstatus,

        ) AND chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes' AS is_digital_native
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions b
    JOIN
        expenses_and_assets e ON b.bankexpref = e.expemplref
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref,
        FLOOR(c.tenureyrs / 4) AS cohort_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record c
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        co.cohort_quarter,
        dn.is_digital_native,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        SUM(b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / (2 * COUNT(DISTINCT co.clientref)) AS engagement_score,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN (b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS high_engagement_count,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN (b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT co.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN dn.is_digital_native AND (b.bankrelscore + b.idverscore) / 2 > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
            END
        ) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN dn.is_digital_native THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_dn
    FROM 
        cohorts co
    JOIN 
        core_record c ON co.clientref = c.clientref
    LEFT JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON c.clientref = dn.expemplref
    LEFT JOIN 
        bank_and_transactions b ON c.clientref = b.bankexpref
    GROUP BY 
        co.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native,
    cohort_size,
    engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_percentage_dn
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;

WITH robot_age AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg, 
        (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rr.rects - rd.instdateval)) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600)) AS ray
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_record AS rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode
),
robot_precision AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.actdetref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN ad.poserrmmval >= 0.1 THEN 'Low/Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS precision_category
    FROM 
        actuation_data AS ad
),
robot_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
        AVG(ad.poserrmmval) AS avg_position_error,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rd.ctrltypeval ORDER BY ad.poserrmmval DESC) AS ape_rank,
        MAX(ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
        AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_fault_prediction_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_age AS ra ON rd.botdetreg = ra.botdetreg
    JOIN 
        robot_precision AS rp ON rd.botdetreg = rp.actdetref
    JOIN 
        actuation_data AS ad ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actdetref
    JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    WHERE 
        rp.precision_category = 'Low/Medium' 
        AND ra.ray > 1
    GROUP BY 
        rd.ctrltypeval, ad.poserrmmval
)
SELECT 
    controller_type, 
    avg_position_error, 
    max_ape_rank, 
    avg_fault_prediction_score, 
    robot_count
FROM 
    robot_summary
GROUP BY 
    controller_type, avg_position_error, max_ape_rank
LIMIT 10;

    -- Assuming the RGB implementation quality score is calculated based on the average of brightness, color accuracy, and number of RGB zones
    (r.rgbbright + r.rgbcoloracc + r.rgbzones) / 3 AS rgb_quality_score,
    -- Assuming the RGB classification is based on the RGB quality score
    CASE 
      WHEN (r.rgbbright + r.rgbcoloracc + r.rgbzones) / 3 > 90 THEN 'High'

      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS rgb_classification
  FROM 
    DeviceIdentity d
    JOIN TestSessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
    JOIN Mechanical m ON d.devregistry = m.mechdevref
    JOIN RGB r ON m.mechregistry = r.rgbmechref
)

WITH EfficiencyMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.flowsoft AS processing_software,
        sp.flowstage AS processing_stage,
        AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
        AVG(sp.proccpu) AS avg_cpu_usage_percent,
        AVG(sp.procgpu) AS avg_gpu_usage_percent,
        AVG(s.gbsize) AS avg_data_size_gb,
        AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage_gb,
        -- Calculate efficiency using the PRU formula
        (
            AVG(sp.flowhrs * (sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu) / 2) /
            AVG(s.gbsize * 10 * LOG(10, sp.facetverts + 10000))
        ) AS efficiency_value
    FROM 
        scanprocessing sp
    JOIN 
        scans s ON sp.equipref = s.equipref AND sp.zoneref = s.zoneref
    GROUP BY 
        sp.flowsoft, sp.flowstage
)
SELECT 
    processing_software,
    processing_stage,
    avg_processing_hours,
    avg_cpu_usage_percent,
    avg_gpu_usage_percent,
    avg_data_size_gb,
    efficiency_value,
    -- Determine efficiency status based on efficiency value
    CASE 
        WHEN efficiency_value < 0.5 THEN 'High Efficiency'
        WHEN efficiency_value < 1.0 THEN 'Moderate Efficiency'
        ELSE 'Bottleneck'
    END AS efficiency_status,
    -- Count total workflows for each software and stage
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY processing_software, processing_stage) AS total_workflows
FROM 
    EfficiencyMetrics;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trader_omi_distribution(
    trader_ref VARCHAR
) RETURNS TABLE (
    trader_id VARCHAR,
    transaction_count INT,
    omi_mean FLOAT,
    omi_stddev FLOAT,
    omi_min FLOAT,
    omi_max FLOAT
) AS $ $
DECLARE
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        t.tradereg AS trader_id,
        COUNT(tr.transreg) AS transaction_count,
        AVG(tr.modfreq) AS omi_mean,
        STDDEV(tr.modfreq) AS omi_stddev,
        MIN(tr.modfreq) AS omi_min,
        MAX(tr.modfreq) AS omi_max
    FROM
        trader t
    JOIN
        transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    WHERE
        t.tradereg = trader_ref
    GROUP BY
        t.tradereg;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH SensorQuality AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        (t1.sensres * t2.pollratehz * t1.dpires) / 1000 AS sensor_quality_score
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
),
ComfortIndex AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        (t3.gripdur * CASE t3.tempres 
            WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 3 
            ELSE 0 
            END 
            * CASE t3.humidres 
                WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 
                WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2 
                WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 3 
                ELSE 0 
                END) AS comfort_index
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
    JOIN 
        physicaldurability AS t3 ON t2.perfregistry = t3.physperfref
),
PremiumDevices AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.devregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN t3.tempres = 'Premium' AND t3.humidres = 'Premium' THEN 'Yes' 
            ELSE 'No' 
            END AS is_premium
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        performance AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.perfregistry
    JOIN 
        physicaldurability AS t3 ON t2.perfregistry = t3.physperfref
)
SELECT 
    t1.makername, 
    t1.modnum, 
    t1.dpires AS dpi_resolution, 
    t2.pollratehz AS polling_rate, 
    sq.sensor_quality_score, 
    ci.comfort_index, 
    pd.is_premium
FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN 
    testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    SensorQuality AS sq ON t1.devregistry = sq.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    ComfortIndex AS ci ON t1.devregistry = ci.devregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    PremiumDevices AS pd ON t1.devregistry = pd.devregistry
ORDER BY 
    sq.sensor_quality_score DESC, 
    ci.comfort_index DESC;

WITH user_demo AS (
    SELECT 
        substatus AS subscription_status,
        (user_preferences->>'interests')::text AS shared_interests,
        (user_preferences->>'activity_level')::text AS activity_level,
        (user_preferences->>'satisfaction_score')::decimal AS satisfaction_score,
        ageval AS age,
        gendlbl AS gender,
        occulbl AS occupation
    FROM users
),
user_scores AS (
    SELECT
        ud.subscription_status,
        ud.shared_interests,
        ud.activity_level,
        ud.satisfaction_score,
        ud.age,
        ud.gender,
        ud.occupation,
        u.subdays * 
            CASE u.substatus
                WHEN 'Premium' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Enterprise' THEN 2
                WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1
            END AS usv,
        u.ageval * 
            CASE u.gendlbl
                WHEN 'M' THEN 1.2
                WHEN 'F' THEN 1.5
                ELSE 1
            END * 
            CASE u.occulbl
                WHEN 'Professional' THEN 1.3
                WHEN 'Student' THEN 0.8
                ELSE 1
            END AS uds
    FROM user_demo AS ud
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.substatus = ud.subscription_status
),
grouped_users AS (
    SELECT
        subscription_status,
        shared_interests,
        activity_level,
        satisfaction_score,
        age,
        gender,
        occupation,
        AVG(usv) AS avg_usv,
        AVG(uds) AS avg_uds,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count,
        STRING_AGG(shared_interests, ',') AS aggregated_interests
    FROM user_scores
    GROUP BY subscription_status, shared_interests, activity_level, satisfaction_score, age, gender, occupation
)
SELECT
    subscription_status,
    shared_interests,
    activity_level,
    satisfaction_score,
    age,
    gender,
    occupation,
    avg_usv,
    avg_uds,
    aggregated_interests
FROM grouped_users
WHERE user_count > 10
ORDER BY avg_uds DESC;

                    market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'rsi14spot'
                )::NUMERIC - 50
            ) +
            ABS(
                (
                    market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'macdtrail'
                )::NUMERIC
            ) +
            (
                (
                    market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'bbandspan'
                )::NUMERIC * 0.01
            )
        ) / 3 *
        CASE
            WHEN market_sentiment_indicators->'momentum'->>'techmeter' = 'Buy' THEN 1
            WHEN market_sentiment_indicators->'momentum'->>'techmeter' = 'Sell' THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END AS technical_signal_strength
    FROM
        analyticsindicators
)
SELECT
    (
        market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'bbandspan'
    )::NUMERIC AS bollinger_band_width,
    (

    ) AS technical_meter_direction,
    technical_signal_strength
FROM

update_tss AS (

insert_tss AS (

CREATE VIEW risk_summary AS
WITH technical_evasion AS (
    SELECT 
        t2.accindex,
        (0.4 * t1.vpnratio) + (0.3 * t1.proxycount/10) + (0.3 * t1.ipcountrynum/20) AS tei_metric
    FROM 
        technicalinfo t1
    JOIN account t2 ON t1.technetref = t2.accindex
)
SELECT 
    t2.accindex,
    t2.acctident,
    t2.acctcreatedate,
    t2.acctagespan,
    t2.acctstatus,
    t2.acctcategory,
    t2.authstatus,
    t1.tei_metric,
    CASE 
        WHEN t1.tei_metric < 0.3 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN t1.tei_metric < 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_level
FROM 
    technical_evasion t1
JOIN account t2 ON t1.accindex = t2.accindex;

SELECT 
    t1.audregistry AS audio_id,
    t2.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t2.modnum AS model_number,
    t1.thdpct AS total_harmonic_distortion,
    t1.spksensedb AS speaker_sensitivity,
    t1.audlatms AS audio_latency,
    -- Calculate AQI as per the given formula
    (
        (10 * t1.spksensedb) + 
        (5 * (100 - (t1.thdpct * 100))) + 
        (3 * (100 - (t1.audlatms * 10)))
    ) AS calculated_AQI
FROM 
    audioandmedia AS t1
JOIN 
    deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.auddevref = t2.devregistry
WHERE 
    -- Assuming Audio Quality is represented by the calculated AQI
    (
        (10 * t1.spksensedb) + 
        (5 * (100 - (t1.thdpct * 100))) + 
        (3 * (100 - (t1.audlatms * 10)))
    ) > 8.0
ORDER BY 
    calculated_AQI DESC;

WITH ArtifactRiskFactors AS (
    SELECT
        artregistry AS artifact_id,
        artname AS artifact_name,
        ARRAY[
            envsensitivity,
            lightsensitivity,
            tempsensitivity,
            humiditysensitivity,
            vibrasensitivity,
            pollutantsensitivity,
            pestsensitivity,
            handlesensitivity,
            transportsensitivity,
            displaysensitivity,
            storagesensitivity
        ] AS sensitivities,
        (
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN envsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1
                    WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 2
                    WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 3
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) / 11
        ) AS risk_factor
    FROM
        sensitivitydata
        JOIN artifactscore ON sensitivitydata.artref = artifactscore.artregistry
    GROUP BY
        artregistry,
        artname,
        envsensitivity,
        lightsensitivity,
        tempsensitivity,
        humiditysensitivity,
        vibrasensitivity,
        pollutantsensitivity,
        pestsensitivity,
        handlesensitivity,
        transportsensitivity,
        displaysensitivity,
        storagesensitivity
)
SELECT
    artifact_id,
    artifact_name,
    risk_factor,
    json_agg(sensitivities) AS sensitivity_ratings
FROM
    ArtifactRiskFactors
WHERE
    risk_factor > 7
GROUP BY
    artifact_id,
    artifact_name,
    risk_factor
ORDER BY
    risk_factor DESC;

WITH sensitivity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry AS artregistry,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS envsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS lightsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS tempsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS humiditysensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS vibrasensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS pollutantsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS pestsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS handlesensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS transportsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS displaysensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS storagesensitivity_count
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artregistry
),
total_sensitive_factors AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry,
        SUM(
            envsensitivity_count +
            lightsensitivity_count +
            tempsensitivity_count +
            humiditysensitivity_count +
            vibrasensitivity_count +
            pollutantsensitivity_count +
            pestsensitivity_count +
            handlesensitivity_count +
            transportsensitivity_count +
            displaysensitivity_count +
            storagesensitivity_count
        ) AS total_sensitive_factors
    FROM 
        sensitivity_counts
    GROUP BY 
        artregistry
),
showcase_readings AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        t3.showcasereg,
        t3.airtightness,
        t4.tempc,
        t4.relhumidity
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artrefused
    JOIN 
        showcases AS t3 ON t2.showcaserefused = t3.showcasereg
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore AS t4 ON t3.showcasereg = t4.showcaseref
),
deterioration_check AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS is_rapid_deterioration
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    LEFT JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
),
accelerated_deterioration_check AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.MDR > 5 AND (
                t3.envsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.lightsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.tempsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.humiditysensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.vibrasensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.pollutantsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.pestsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.handlesensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.transportsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.displaysensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.storagesensitivity_count >= 2
            ) THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    LEFT JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    LEFT JOIN 
        sensitivity_counts AS t3 ON t1.artregistry = t3.artregistry
)

SELECT 
    t1.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    t1.artname AS artifact_name,
    t5.is_rapid_deterioration AS is_in_rapid_deterioration,
    t6.meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria AS meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria,
    t4.total_sensitive_factors AS num_sensitive_factors,
    t2.airtightness AS current_display_case_condition,
    t3.tempc AS current_temperature_in_celsius,
    t3.relhumidity AS current_relative_humidity
FROM 
    showcase_readings AS t2
JOIN 
    total_sensitive_factors AS t4 ON t2.artregistry = t4.artregistry
JOIN 
    deterioration_check AS t5 ON t2.artregistry = t5.artregistry
JOIN 
    accelerated_deterioration_check AS t6 ON t2.artregistry = t6.artregistry
JOIN 
    artifactscore AS t1 ON t2.artregistry = t1.artregistry
JOIN 
    environmentalreadingscore AS t3 ON t2.showcasereg = t3.showcaseref;

WITH sensitivity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry AS artregistry,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS envsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS lightsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS tempsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS humiditysensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS vibrasensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS pollutantsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS pestsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS handlesensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS transportsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS displaysensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS storagesensitivity_count
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artregistry
),
total_sensitive_factors AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry,
        SUM(
            envsensitivity_count +
            lightsensitivity_count +
            tempsensitivity_count +
            humiditysensitivity_count +
            vibrasensitivity_count +
            pollutantsensitivity_count +
            pestsensitivity_count +
            handlesensitivity_count +
            transportsensitivity_count +
            displaysensitivity_count +
            storagesensitivity_count
        ) AS total_sensitive_factors
    FROM 
        sensitivity_counts
    GROUP BY 
        artregistry
),
showcase_readings AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        t3.showcasereg,
        t3.airtightness,
        t4.tempc,
        t4.relhumidity
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artrefused
    JOIN 
        showcases AS t3 ON t2.showcaserefused = t3.showcasereg
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore AS t4 ON t3.showcasereg = t4.showcaseref
),
deterioration_check AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS is_rapid_deterioration
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    LEFT JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
),
accelerated_deterioration_check AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN t3.MDR > 5 AND (
                t4.envsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.lightsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.tempsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.humiditysensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.vibrasensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.pollutantsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.pestsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.handlesensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.transportsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.displaysensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t4.storagesensitivity_count >= 2
            ) THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria
    FROM 
        artifactratings AS t3
    JOIN 
        artifactscore AS t1 ON t3.artref = t1.artregistry
    LEFT JOIN 
        sensitivity_counts AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artregistry
)

SELECT 
    t1.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    t1.artname AS artifact_name,
    t5.is_rapid_deterioration AS is_in_rapid_deterioration,
    t6.meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria AS meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria,
    t4.total_sensitive_factors AS num_sensitive_factors,
    t2.airtightness AS current_display_case_condition,
    t3.tempc AS current_temperature_in_celsius,
    t3.relhumidity AS current_relative_humidity
FROM 
    showcase_readings AS t2
JOIN 
    total_sensitive_factors AS t4 ON t2.artregistry = t4.artregistry
JOIN 
    deterioration_check AS t5 ON t2.artregistry = t5.artregistry
JOIN 
    accelerated_deterioration_check AS t6 ON t2.artregistry = t6.artregistry
JOIN 
    artifactscore AS t1 ON t2.artregistry = t1.artregistry
JOIN 
    environmentalreadingscore AS t3 ON t2.showcasereg = t3.showcaseref;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref CHAR(12))
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
DECLARE
    v_total_score NUMERIC;
    v_score_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- Initialize variables
    v_total_score := 0;
    v_score_count := 0;

    -- Fetch scores from ContentBehavior
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(cntsimscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(cntuniqscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(cntdiverseval, 0) 
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM ContentBehavior
    WHERE cntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM ContentBehavior
    WHERE cntref = p_cntref
    AND (cntsimscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        cntuniqscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        cntdiverseval IS NOT NULL);

    -- Fetch scores from ModerationAction
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(netinflscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(coordscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(authenscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(credscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(reputscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(trustval, 0) + 
        COALESCE(impactval, 0)
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM ModerationAction
    WHERE macntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM ModerationAction
    WHERE macntref = p_cntref
    AND (netinflscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        coordscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        authenscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        credscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        reputscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        trustval IS NOT NULL OR 
        impactval IS NOT NULL);

    -- Fetch scores from MessagingAnalysis
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(msgsimscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(msgfreq, 0) + 
        COALESCE(msgtgtdiv, 0) + 
        COALESCE(convnatval, 0) + 
        COALESCE(sentvar, 0) + 
        COALESCE(langsoph, 0) + 
        COALESCE(txtuniq, 0) + 
        COALESCE(topiccoh, 0)
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM MessagingAnalysis
    WHERE msgcntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM MessagingAnalysis
    WHERE msgcntref = p_cntref
    AND (msgsimscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        msgfreq IS NOT NULL OR 
        msgtgtdiv IS NOT NULL OR 
        convnatval IS NOT NULL OR 
        sentvar IS NOT NULL OR 
        langsoph IS NOT NULL OR 
        txtuniq IS NOT NULL OR 
        topiccoh IS NOT NULL);

    -- Handle division by zero
    IF v_score_count = 0 THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    ELSE
        RETURN v_total_score / v_score_count;
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Log error and return NULL on exception
        RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref CHAR(12))
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
DECLARE
    v_total_score NUMERIC;
    v_score_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
    -- Initialize variables
    v_total_score := 0;
    v_score_count := 0;

    -- Fetch scores from ContentBehavior
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(cntsimscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(cntuniqscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(cntdiverseval, 0) 
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM ContentBehavior
    WHERE cntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM ContentBehavior
    WHERE cntref = p_cntref
    AND (cntsimscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        cntuniqscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        cntdiverseval IS NOT NULL);

    -- Fetch scores from ModerationAction
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(netinflscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(coordscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(authenscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(credscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(reputscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(trustval, 0) + 
        COALESCE(impactval, 0)
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM ModerationAction
    WHERE macntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM ModerationAction
    WHERE macntref = p_cntref
    AND (netinflscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        coordscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        authenscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        credscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        reputscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        trustval IS NOT NULL OR 
        impactval IS NOT NULL);

    -- Fetch scores from MessagingAnalysis
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(msgsimscore, 0) + 
        COALESCE(msgfreq, 0) + 
        COALESCE(msgtgtdiv, 0) + 
        COALESCE(convnatval, 0) + 
        COALESCE(sentvar, 0) + 
        COALESCE(langsoph, 0) + 
        COALESCE(txtuniq, 0) + 
        COALESCE(topiccoh, 0)
    INTO v_total_score
    FROM MessagingAnalysis
    WHERE msgcntref = p_cntref;

    -- Update score count based on fetched scores
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) 
    INTO v_score_count
    FROM MessagingAnalysis
    WHERE msgcntref = p_cntref
    AND (msgsimscore IS NOT NULL OR 
        msgfreq IS NOT NULL OR 
        msgtgtdiv IS NOT NULL OR 
        convnatval IS NOT NULL OR 
        sentvar IS NOT NULL OR 
        langsoph IS NOT NULL OR 
        txtuniq IS NOT NULL OR 
        topiccoh IS NOT NULL);

    -- Handle division by zero
    IF v_score_count = 0 THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    ELSE
        RETURN v_total_score / v_score_count;
    END IF;

EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Log error and return NULL on exception
        RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH qualifying_robots AS (

        rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_capacity_kg,
        rd.reachmmval AS reach_mm,
        rd.instdateval AS installation_date,
        rd.fwversionval AS firmware_version,
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type,
        op.totopshrval AS total_operating_hours,
        ps.conditionindexval AS joint_degradation_index,
        jc.j1tempval AS joint_1_temp,
        jc.j2tempval AS joint_2_temp,
        jc.j3tempval AS joint_3_temp,
        jc.j4tempval AS joint_4_temp,
        jc.j5tempval AS joint_5_temp,
        jc.j6tempval AS joint_6_temp
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    JOIN 
        joint_condition jc ON rd.botdetreg = jc.jcdetref
    WHERE 
        ps.conditionindexval > 1.5 
        AND (
            jc.j1tempval > 65 OR jc.j2tempval > 65 OR jc.j3tempval > 65 
            OR jc.j4tempval > 65 OR jc.j5tempval > 65 OR jc.j6tempval > 65
        )
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
)
SELECT 
    qr.robot_id,
    qr.manufacturer,
    qr.model_series,
    qr.robot_type,
    qr.payload_capacity_kg,
    qr.reach_mm,
    qr.installation_date,
    qr.firmware_version,
    qr.controller_type,
    (
        COUNT(*) * SUM(qr.total_operating_hours * qr.joint_degradation_index) 
        - SUM(qr.total_operating_hours) * SUM(qr.joint_degradation_index)
    ) / (
        COUNT(*) * SUM(qr.total_operating_hours * qr.total_operating_hours) 
        - POWER(SUM(qr.total_operating_hours), 2)
    ) AS regression_slope
FROM 
    qualifying_robots qr
GROUP BY 
    qr.robot_id, qr.manufacturer, qr.model_series, qr.robot_type, 
    qr.payload_capacity_kg, qr.reach_mm, qr.installation_date,

    t3.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'weirdness_score' AS overall_weirdness_score,
    t3.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'bot_rating_recent' AS recent_bot_rating
FROM 
    account AS t1
JOIN 
    moderationaction AS t2 ON t1.accindex = t2.macntref
JOIN 
    securitydetection AS t3 ON t2.masedetref = t3.secdetkey
WHERE 
    t3.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' > 70 
ORDER BY 
    overall_weirdness_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH sse AS (
  SELECT 
    asdkey, 
    (
      SUM(
        CASE 
          WHEN socsup = 'Strong' THEN 3 
          WHEN socsup = 'Moderate' THEN 2 
          ELSE 1 
        END + CASE 
              WHEN relqual = 'Good' THEN 3 
              WHEN relqual = 'Fair' THEN 2 
              WHEN relqual = 'Poor' THEN 1 
              ELSE 0 
            END
      ) / COUNT(*)
    ) AS sse 
  FROM 
    assessmentsocialanddiagnosis 
  GROUP BY 
    asdkey
), 
latest_sse AS (
  SELECT 
    a.abkey, 
    s.sse 
  FROM 
    assessmentbasics a 
  LEFT JOIN sse s ON a.abkey = s.asdkey 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      asdkey, 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
        PARTITION BY asdkey 
        ORDER BY 
          abkey DESC
      ) AS row_num 
    FROM 
      assessmentsocialanddiagnosis
  ) ranked ON s.asdkey = ranked.asdkey 
  WHERE 
    row_num = 1
), 
avg_missed_appointments AS (
  SELECT 
    patref, 
    AVG(missappt) AS avg_missed_appointments 
  FROM 
    encounters 
  GROUP BY 
    patref
) 
SELECT 
  p.patkey, 
  a.avg_missed_appointments, 
  l.sse 
FROM 
  patients p 
  LEFT JOIN avg_missed_appointments a ON p.patkey = a.patref 
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
      patownerref, 
      sse, 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( 
        PARTITION BY patownerref 
        ORDER BY 
          abkey DESC
      ) AS row_num 
    FROM 
      latest_sse
  ) l ON p.patkey = l.patownerref 
WHERE 
  row_num = 1;

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.devregistry, 
    t1.profcount, 
    (t1.dpires / 1000.0) * (1 - t1.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10 AS spi, 
    (
      (t2.cgpi / 10.0) * (1 + t1.profcount / 5.0) * (
        (spi + t2.irs) / 15.0
      )
    ) AS par
  FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN interactionandcontrol AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.interactdevref
)
SELECT 
  devregistry AS "Device Registry ID", 
  cgpi AS "Competitive Gaming Performance", 
  profcount AS "Profile Count", 
  spi AS "Sensor Performance", 
  irs AS "Input Responsiveness Score", 
  par AS "Calculated Adoption Rate Value"
FROM 
  cte
WHERE 
  par > 8.5;

CREATE FUNCTION calculate_rcp(vehicle_reg VARCHAR(20))
RETURNS VARCHAR(20)
AS $ 
DECLARE 
    dist_done NUMERIC(9,2),
    dist_left NUMERIC(9,2),
    completion_status VARCHAR(20);
BEGIN 
    -- Get the distance done and distance left for the vehicle
    SELECT 
        distdonekm INTO dist_done,
        distleftkm INTO dist_left
    FROM transportinfo
    WHERE vehiclereg = vehicle_reg;
    
    -- Calculate the completion status
    IF dist_done + dist_left = 0 THEN
        completion_status := 'Not Started';
    ELSE
        completion_status := ((dist_done / (dist_done + dist_left)) * 100) || '%';
    END IF;
    
    RETURN completion_status;
END; $

WITH daily_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(seshstart) AS session_date, 
        AVG(engscore) AS daily_avg_uer
    FROM 
        sessions
    GROUP BY 
        session_date
)
SELECT 
    s.seshstart AS session_date,
    s.engscore AS calculated_uer,
    d.daily_avg_uer
FROM 
    sessions s
JOIN 
    daily_avg d ON DATE(s.seshstart) = d.session_date
WHERE 
    s.engscore > d.daily_avg_uer
ORDER BY 
    session_date;

WITH MaintenanceCostEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        m.maintregistry, 
        (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS mce
    FROM 
        maintenance AS m
    JOIN 
        plant AS p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
)
SELECT 
    maintregistry
FROM 
    MaintenanceCostEfficiency
ORDER BY 
    mce DESC
LIMIT 10;

CREATE VIEW container_depletion_rank_view AS
SELECT
    c.containregistry,
    c.containmodel,
    c.volliters,
    c.masskg,
    c.containflag,
    c.coolkind,
    c.coolmass,
    c.coolremainpct,
    c.coolrefills,
    c.refilllatest,
    c.refillnext,
    c.batterypct,
    c.pwrfeed,
    c.pwrbackupflag,
    s.shipmentregistry,
    s.timemark,
    s.routealign,
    s.customsflag,
    s.imppermitref,
    s.exppermitref,
    s.regprofile,
    s.insureflag,
    s.insureref,
    s.qualcheck,
    s.integritymark,
    s.contamlevel,
    s.sterilemark,
    s.packagestate,
    s.sealflag,
    s.sealref,
    s.tampersign,
    s.handlingguide,
    s.storagepose,
    s.generalnote,
    CASE
        WHEN c.coolremainpct < 20 THEN 'High Depletion'
        WHEN c.coolremainpct < 50 THEN 'Medium Depletion'
        ELSE 'Low Depletion'
    END AS depletion_status
FROM
    container c
JOIN
    shipments s ON c.shipown = s.shipmentregistry
ORDER BY
    c.coolremainpct ASC;

WITH ranked_containers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry AS container_id,
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_temp_stability_score,
        -- Assuming Container Risk Index (CRI) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS container_risk_index, 
        -- Assuming Risk Rank is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        0 AS risk_rank,
        dl.logflag AS sensor_data_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(sd.tempstabidx) DESC) AS row_num
    FROM 
        Container c
    JOIN 
        SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
    JOIN 
        DataLogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog
    GROUP BY 
        c.containregistry, dl.logflag
)
SELECT 
    container_id,
    max_temp_stability_score,
    container_risk_index,
    risk_rank,
    sensor_data_status,
    json_build_object(
        'TempDevCount', MAX(sd.tempdevcount),
        'CritEvents', MAX(sd.critevents),
        'TempStabIdx', MAX(sd.tempstabidx),
        'CoolRemainPct', c.coolremainpct,
        -- Assuming Temperature Breach Severity (TBS) is an external knowledge and not directly in the database
        -- For demonstration, using a placeholder value. Replace with actual logic if available.
        'TempBreachSeverity', 0
    ) AS diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    ranked_containers rc
JOIN 
    Container c ON rc.container_id = c.containregistry
JOIN 
    SensorData sd ON c.containregistry = sd.containlink
WHERE 
    rc.row_num <= 10
GROUP BY 
    rc.container_id, rc.max_temp_stability_score, rc.container_risk_index, rc.risk_rank, rc.sensor_data_status, c.coolremainpct
ORDER BY 
    rc.row_num;

SELECT
    o.observstation AS observatory_name,
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS signals_meeting_thresholds,
    AVG(sp.anomscore) AS avg_origin_score,
    AVG(s.freqmhz / s.bwhz) AS avg_frequency_ratios,
    (COUNT(s.signalregistry) * 100.0 / (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM signals s
        INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
        WHERE sp.techsigprob > 0.5
    )) AS percentage_of_candidates
FROM observatories o
INNER JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
INNER JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
WHERE sp.techsigprob > 0.5
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY signals_meeting_thresholds DESC;

WITH SiteDensity AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(spc.pointdense) AS avg_density
    FROM 
        scanfeatures sf
    JOIN 
        scanpointcloud spc ON sf.zoneref = spc.arcref
    GROUP BY 
        sf.zoneref
),
ExtractionEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_extraction
    FROM 
        scanfeatures sf
    GROUP BY 
        sf.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    sd.site_code,
    sd.avg_density AS avg_density_value,
    ee.avg_extraction AS avg_extraction_value
FROM 
    SiteDensity sd
JOIN 
    ExtractionEfficiency ee ON sd.site_code = ee.site_code;

WITH SensitiveArtifacts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry, 
        t1.artname, 
        t1.mattype, 
        t2.lightsensitivity, 
        t3.lightlux
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments AS t4 ON t1.artregistry = t4.artrefexamined
    JOIN 
        lightandradiationreadings AS t3 ON t4.lightreadrefobserved = t3.lightradregistry
    WHERE 
        t2.lightsensitivity ILIKE '%sensitive%'
),
LightExposureStatus AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry, 
        artname, 
        mattype, 
        lightsensitivity,
        lightlux,
        CASE 
            WHEN lightlux > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure' 
            ELSE 'Within Limits' 
        END AS exposure_status
    FROM 
        SensitiveArtifacts
)
SELECT 
    artregistry AS registry_number,
    artname AS name,
    mattype AS material_type,
    lightsensitivity AS light_sensitivity,
    exposure_status AS current_status
FROM 
    LightExposureStatus;

WITH station_info AS (
    SELECT 
        l.stationname, 
        l.locationtype, 
        AVG(ww.waterqualityindex) AS avg_water_quality_index, 
        AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) AS avg_wrmi_score, 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tswg.powerqualityindex < 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS water_saving_systems_count, 
        'Water Quality Classification' AS water_quality_classification, 
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) < 0.5 THEN 'Conservation Needed' 
            WHEN AVG(tswg.powerqualityindex) < 0.7 THEN 'Monitoring Advised' 
            ELSE 'Sustainable Management' 
        END AS management_situation 
    FROM 
        location l 
    JOIN 
        waterandwaste ww ON l.loceqref = ww.watereqref 
    JOIN 
        thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON l.loceqref = tswg.thermaleqref 
    GROUP BY 
        l.stationname, l.locationtype

WITH mesh_quality AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.zoneref,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN uvmapqual = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(facetverts / facetfaces) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
        AVG(facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        AVG(geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
        CASE 
            WHEN AVG(facetresmm) < 1.0 AND AVG(geomdeltamm) < 0.1 THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN AVG(facetresmm) < 2.0 AND AVG(geomdeltamm) < 0.5 THEN 'High'
            WHEN AVG(facetresmm) < 5.0 AND AVG(geomdeltamm) < 1.0 THEN 'Standard'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh sm
    GROUP BY 
        sm.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,

    mq.avg_complexity_ratio,
    mq.avg_resolution_mm,
    mq.avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
    mq.mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    mesh_quality mq ON s.zoneregistry = mq.zoneref
ORDER BY 
    mq.mesh_quality DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_market_risk(
    p_dlyflow BIGINT,
    p_esccomprate NUMERIC,
    p_interscore NUMERIC,
    p_vendcount INTEGER,
    p_mktspan INTEGER
)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        p_dlyflow / 1000.0 +
        (p_esccomprate * 0.2) +
        (p_interscore * 0.3) +
        (p_vendcount * 0.1) -
        (p_mktspan / 100.0)
    );
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH silent_supporters AS (

        f.tierstep AS membership_tier, 
        SUM(ms.spendusd) AS economic_impact,

        -- Calculate revenue per view
        SUM(ms.spendusd) / NULLIF(SUM(i.giftvalusd), 0) AS revenue_per_view, 
        -- Classify content preference
        CASE 
            WHEN e.contpref = 'Music' THEN 'Content Consumer (Music)'
            WHEN e.contpref = 'Dance' THEN 'Content Consumer (Dance)'
            WHEN e.contpref = 'Gaming' THEN 'Content Consumer (Gaming)'

        fans f
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    LEFT JOIN 
        interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
    WHERE 
        f.statustag = 'Silent Supporter'
    GROUP BY 
        f.userregistry, f.nicklabel, f.statustag, f.tierstep, e.engrate
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    economic_impact, 
    engagement_rate, 
    activity_ratio, 
    membership_tier, 
    revenue_per_view, 
    content_preference_classification
FROM 
    silent_supporters;

DO $$
DECLARE
    v_enum_exists INT;
BEGIN
    -- Check if the enum type already exists
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_enum_exists
    FROM pg_type
    WHERE typname = 'battery_efficiency';

    -- If the enum type does not exist, create it
    IF v_enum_exists = 0 THEN
        EXECUTE 'CREATE TYPE battery_efficiency AS ENUM (''Low'', ''Medium'', ''High'')';
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE (
    device_id VARCHAR,
    efficiency_value NUMERIC,
    efficiency_classification battery_efficiency
) AS $
DECLARE
    v_device_id VARCHAR;
    v_efficiency_value NUMERIC;
    v_efficiency_classification battery_efficiency;
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        di.devregistry AS device_id,
        (ts.battcapmah / NULLIF(di.pwractmw, 0)) AS efficiency_value,
        CASE
            WHEN (ts.battcapmah / NULLIF(di.pwractmw, 0)) > 100 THEN 'High'::battery_efficiency
            WHEN (ts.battcapmah / NULLIF(di.pwractmw, 0)) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'::battery_efficiency

CREATE TABLE market_impact_cost_log (
    log_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    ordersmark TEXT,
    mic NUMERIC,
    calculated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE recalc_market_impact_cost()
AS $ $
DECLARE
    current_market_factor NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Get the current market factor
    SELECT mkteffect INTO current_market_factor
    FROM systemmonitoring
    ORDER BY systemmonitoringpivot DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Calculate MIC for new orders and log the values
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
    SELECT
        o.recordvault,
        (o.notionsum * current_market_factor) AS calculated_mic
    FROM
        orders o
    WHERE
        o.orderflow = 'New';
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH facility_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey AS facility_id,
        (
            -- Calculate PFIS: Average of functional impairment scores
            AVG(
                CASE 
                    WHEN a.funcimp = 'Severe' THEN 3
                    WHEN a.funcimp = 'Moderate' THEN 2
                    WHEN a.funcimp = 'Mild' THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) AS pfis,
        (
            -- Calculate FRAI: Average of resource adequacy scores
            AVG(
                CASE 
                    WHEN f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
                    WHEN f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate' THEN 2
                    WHEN f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Limited' THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) AS frai
    FROM 
        facilities f
    JOIN 
        clinicians c ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
    JOIN 
        patients p ON c.clinkey = p.clinleadref
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics ab ON p.patkey = ab.patownerref
    JOIN 
        assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a ON ab.abkey = a.asdkey
    GROUP BY 
        f.fackey
),
rdd_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        facility_id,
        ROUND(pfis - frai, 2) AS rdd
    FROM 
        facility_metrics
)
SELECT 
    facility_id, rdd
FROM 
    rdd_scores
ORDER BY 
    rdd DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH treatment_adherence AS (

    JOIN 
        treatmentbasics AS tr ON t.txref = tr.txkey
    JOIN 
        encounters AS e ON tr.encref = e.enckey
    GROUP BY 
        t.txadh, e.facid
),
patient_stability AS (
    SELECT 
        e.facid AS facility_id, 
        SUM(tb.crisisint) AS total_crisis_interventions, 
        SUM(e.missappt) AS total_missed_appointments, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.patref) AS total_patients
    FROM 
        encounters AS e
    JOIN 
        treatmentbasics AS tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
    GROUP BY 
        e.facid
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.facility_id, 
        -- Calculate TAR
        SUM(CASE WHEN ta.adherence_level = 'High' THEN ta.adherence_count ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ta.adherence_count), 0) AS tar, 
        -- Calculate PSM
        (ps.total_patients * 1.0 / NULLIF(ps.total_crisis_interventions + ps.total_missed_appointments, 0)) AS psm
    FROM 
        treatment_adherence AS ta
    JOIN 
        patient_stability AS ps ON ta.facility_id = ps.facility_id
    GROUP BY 
        ta.facility_id
),
performance_quadrants AS (
    SELECT 
        m.facility_id, 
        m.tar, 
        m.psm, 
        -- Determine quadrant based on TAR and PSM
        CASE 
            WHEN m.tar >= 0.75 AND m.psm >= 0.75 THEN 'Q1' 
            WHEN m.tar >= 0.75 AND m.psm < 0.75 THEN 'Q2' 
            WHEN m.tar < 0.75 AND m.psm >= 0.75 THEN 'Q3' 
            ELSE 'Q4' 
        END AS quadrant
    FROM 
        metrics AS m
)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_trader_omi_distribution(trader_ref VARCHAR)
RETURNS TABLE (trader_id VARCHAR, transaction_count INT, omi_mean FLOAT, omi_stddev FLOAT, omi_min FLOAT, omi_max FLOAT)
AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        t.tradereg AS trader_id,
        COUNT(tr.transreg) AS transaction_count,
        AVG(tr.modfreq) AS omi_mean,
        STDDEV(tr.modfreq) AS omi_stddev,
        MIN(tr.modfreq) AS omi_min,
        MAX(tr.modfreq) AS omi_max
    FROM 
        trader t
    JOIN 
        transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
    WHERE 
        t.tradereg = trader_ref
    GROUP BY 
        t.tradereg;
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH readability_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        catlabel AS article_category,
        difflevel AS complexity_level,
        (
            readsec * LOG(wordlen) / 
            CASE 
                WHEN difflevel ILIKE 'Basic' THEN 1
                WHEN difflevel ILIKE 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                WHEN difflevel ILIKE 'Advanced' THEN 2
                ELSE 1.2
            END
        ) AS readability_score,
        (engagement_metrics ->> 'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate
    FROM 
        articles
),
average_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        complexity_level,
        AVG(readability_score) AS avg_readability_score,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        readability_scores
    GROUP BY 
        article_category, complexity_level
),
correlation_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        CORR(avg_readability_score, avg_engagement_rate) AS correlation_score
    FROM 
        average_scores
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
)
SELECT 
    a.article_category,
    a.complexity_level,
    a.avg_readability_score,
    a.avg_engagement_rate,
    c.correlation_score,
    a.article_count
FROM 
    average_scores a
JOIN 
    correlation_scores c ON a.article_category = c.article_category;

WITH safety_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
        (
            10 * (safety_metrics->>'overloads')::INT
            + 5 * COALESCE((safety_metrics->>'collisions')::INT, 0)
            + CASE 
                WHEN safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Normal' THEN 0
                WHEN safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Warning' THEN 10
                ELSE 20 
            END
            + 8 * COALESCE((safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::INT, 0)
            + 6 * (safety_metrics->>'zone_violations')::INT
            + 4 * (safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::INT
            + CASE 
                WHEN safety_metrics->>'calibration_state' = 'Valid' THEN 0
                ELSE 5 
            END
        ) AS safety_score
    FROM performance_and_safety
),
high_concern_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        robot_id,
        safety_score
    FROM safety_scores
    WHERE safety_score > 50 
) 
INSERT INTO safety_alerts (robot_id, alert_message)

WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT tradereg
    FROM trader
    WHERE (
        (trading_performance->>'tle' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(trading_performance->>'tle' AS DECIMAL) > 5.0)
        AND (trading_performance->>'risklevel' ILIKE '%Aggressive%')
        OR (trading_performance->>'dtr' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(trading_performance->>'dtr' AS DECIMAL) > 0.5)
    )
),
layering_spoofing_traders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT trdref
    FROM transactionrecord
    WHERE (
        (risk_indicators->>'layerind' ILIKE '%Confirmed%')
        OR (
            (risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' AS DECIMAL) > 0.75)
            AND (risk_indicators->>'omi' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(risk_indicators->>'omi' AS DECIMAL) > 1.0)
        )
    )
),
intense_probes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    JOIN high_risk_traders hrt ON t.tradereg = hrt.tradereg
    JOIN layering_spoofing_traders lst ON t.tradereg = lst.trdref
)

WITH frai_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        fackey, 
        CASE 
            WHEN support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Comprehensive' THEN 3
            WHEN support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Adequate' THEN 2
            WHEN support_and_resources->>'community_resources' = 'Limited' THEN 1
        END AS resource_score
    FROM facilities
),
facility_frai AS (
    SELECT 
        fackey, 
        AVG(resource_score) AS frai
    FROM frai_scores
    GROUP BY fackey
),
suicide_risk_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        facid, 
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')) AS high_risk_count, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_assessments
    FROM encounters AS e
    JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr ON e.abref = asr.asrkey
    GROUP BY facid
),
high_risk_facilities AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.facid, 
        high_risk_count, 
        total_assessments, 
        (high_risk_count::DECIMAL / total_assessments) * 100 AS high_risk_prevalence
    FROM suicide_risk_counts sr
    WHERE (high_risk_count::DECIMAL / total_assessments) * 100 > 20
),
funcimp_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        e.facid, 
        CASE 
            WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Severe' THEN 3
            WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Moderate' THEN 2
            WHEN asd.funcimp = 'Mild' THEN 1
        END AS funcimp_score
    FROM encounters AS e
    JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd ON e.abref = asd.asdkey
),
facility_pfis AS (
    SELECT 
        facid, 
        AVG(funcimp_score) AS pfis
    FROM funcimp_scores
    GROUP BY facid
),
rdd_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        f.facid, 
        pf.pfis, 
        ff.frai, 
        (pf.pfis - ff.frai) AS rdd
    FROM high_risk_facilities f
    JOIN facility_pfis pf ON f.facid = pf.facid
    JOIN facility_frai ff ON f.facid = ff.fackey
)
SELECT 
    rs.facid AS facility_id, 
    rs.pfis, 
    rs.frai, 
    rs.rdd
FROM rdd_scores rs
ORDER BY rs.rdd DESC
LIMIT 100;
