DO $do$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT FROM information_schema.tables
        WHERE table_name = 'container_tss_monitoring'
    ) THEN
        CREATE TABLE container_tss_monitoring (
            containregistry VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY,
            latest_tss REAL,
            last_updated TIMESTAMP
        );
    END IF;
END $do$;

WITH tss_calculation AS (
    SELECT
        containlink,
        (1 - (tempdevcount / 100.0)) * (1 - (critevents / 10.0)) * tempstabidx AS tss
    FROM sensordata
),
update_tss AS (
    UPDATE container_tss_monitoring ctm
    SET
        latest_tss = tc.tss,
        last_updated = NOW()
    FROM tss_calculation tc
    WHERE ctm.containregistry = tc.containlink
    RETURNING ctm.containregistry
),
insert_tss AS (
    INSERT INTO container_tss_monitoring (
        containregistry,
        latest_tss,
        last_updated
    )
    SELECT
        tc.containlink,
        tc.tss,
        NOW()
    FROM tss_calculation tc
    LEFT JOIN update_tss uts
    ON tc.containlink = uts.containregistry
    WHERE uts.containregistry IS NULL
)
SELECT 'Table updated successfully' AS result;

WITH apl_cte AS (
  SELECT 
    commregistry, 
    (
      (
        CASE 
          WHEN vpnflag = 'Yes' THEN 1 
          WHEN vpnflag = 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 
          ELSE 0 
        END * 30
      ) + (
        tornodecount * 2
      ) + (
        CASE 
          WHEN encryptmethod = 'Standard' THEN 1 
          WHEN encryptmethod = 'Enhanced' THEN 2 
          WHEN encryptmethod = 'Custom' THEN 3 
          ELSE 0 
        END * 15
      ) + (connpatscore * 0.2) + (brwsrunique / 20)
    ) AS apl
  FROM 
    communication
) 
SELECT 
  commregistry, 
  apl 
FROM 
  apl_cte 
WHERE 
  apl >= 90;

WITH msi AS (
  SELECT 
    market_sentiment_indicators::json AS data
  FROM analyticsindicators
),
flow_info AS (
  SELECT 
    json_extract_path_text(data, 'flow', 'smartforce') AS smart_trading_flow,
    json_extract_path_text(data, 'big_players', 'whalemotion') AS whale_driven_market_activity
  FROM msi
),
market_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT(json_extract_path_text(quote_depth_snapshot, 'metadata', 'mktcombo')) AS market_pair
  FROM marketdata
)

SELECT 
  flow_info.smart_trading_flow AS flow_category,
  flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity AS whale_driven_market_activity,
  market_pairs.market_pair AS market_pair,
  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_1hr,
  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_4hr,
  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_24hr,
  SUM(
    CASE 
      WHEN (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday > 0 
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) * 100 / COUNT(*) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS smart_trading_success_rate
FROM 
  flow_info
CROSS JOIN market_pairs
LEFT JOIN marketdata ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN marketstats ON marketdata.marketdatanode = marketstats.mdlink
GROUP BY 
  flow_info.smart_trading_flow,
  flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity,
  market_pairs.market_pair
ORDER BY 
  smart_trading_success_rate DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW risk_summary AS
WITH tei_calc AS (
    SELECT
        a.accindex,
        a.acctident AS account_identifier,
        0.4 * ti.vpnratio + 0.3 * ti.proxycount/10 + 0.3 * ti.ipcountrynum/20 AS tei,
        ds.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'riskval'::FLOAT AS risk_value,
        ds.detection_score_profile -> 'overall' ->> 'threatlvl' AS threat_level
    FROM
        account a
    JOIN
        technicalinfo ti ON a.accindex = ti.technetref
    JOIN
        securitydetection ds ON ti.techkey = ds.sectechref
)
SELECT
    account_identifier,
    AVG(tei) AS avg_tei,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(tei) < 0.2 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN AVG(tei) < 0.5 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_level,
    AVG(risk_value) AS avg_risk_value,
    MAX(threat_level) AS max_threat_level
FROM
    tei_calc
GROUP BY
    account_identifier;

    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_disf(
    air_temp_c NUMERIC,
    atmos_transparency NUMERIC,
    humidity_rate NUMERIC,
    lunar_dist_deg NUMERIC,
    min_threshold NUMERIC DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS
$$
BEGIN
    RETURN GREATEST(
        (
            (10 - ABS(air_temp_c - 15) / 10)
            * atmos_transparency
            * (1 - humidity_rate / 200)
            * ((100 - lunar_dist_deg) / 100)
        ),
        min_threshold
    );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH BatteryEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.makername AS maker_name,
        t1.modnum AS model,
        t2.battlifeh AS battery_life,
        t2.battcapmah AS battery_capacity,
        t1.pwractmw AS power_draw,
        (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
        END AS efficiency_classification,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.makername ORDER BY (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0)) AS percentile_ranking

    p_charge_offs SMALLINT,
    p_bankruptcies SMALLINT
) RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        0.4 * p_credit_score / 850 + 
        (1 - p_credit_utilization_ratio) * 0.3 + 
        (1 - p_debt_ratio) * 0.15 + 
        p_credit_age_in_years * 0.05 + 
        (10 - p_delinquency_count) * 0.05 + 
        (10 - p_late_payment_count) * 0.03 + 
        (10 - p_charge_offs) * 0.02 + 
        (10 - p_bankruptcies) * 0.01
    );
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH prog_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        op.currprogval AS program,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count,
        AVG(op.progcyclecount) AS avg_cycle_activity,
        AVG(ps.effectivenessindexval) AS avg_OCE,
        SUM(op.progcyclecount * ps.effectivenessindexval) AS total_weighted_cycles
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval, op.currprogval
),
model_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        model_series,
        SUM(robot_count) AS total_robots,
        AVG(avg_cycle_activity) AS avg_cycle_activity,
        MAX(total_weighted_cycles / NULLIF(robot_count, 0)) AS max_efficiency_score,
        program AS most_efficient_program,
        AVG(avg_OCE) AS avg_OCE
    FROM 
        prog_stats
    GROUP BY 
        model_series
),
underperforming_robots AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,

        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    WHERE 
        ps.effectivenessindexval < (SELECT AVG(effectivenessindexval) FROM performance_and_safety)
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval
)

    ms.model_series,

FROM

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_tes(txkey INT)
RETURNS FLOAT AS
$$
DECLARE
    engagement_score INT;
BEGIN
    SELECT
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Low' THEN 1
                WHEN therapy_details ->> 'engagement' = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    INTO engagement_score
    FROM treatmentbasics
    WHERE txkey = txkey;
    
    RETURN engagement_score;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

    SELECT 
        t.tradereg, 
        t.trading_performance->>'winpct' AS winpct, 
        a.peercorr
    FROM 
        trader t
    JOIN 
        advancedbehavior a ON t.tradereg = a.translink
),
trader_data AS (
    SELECT 
        tradereg, 
        winpct::DECIMAL,
        peercorr,
        CASE WHEN peercorr > 0.5 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_peer_copycat
    FROM 
        trader_raw_data
)
SELECT 
    is_peer_copycat,
    AVG(winpct) AS avg_winpct
FROM 
    trader_data
GROUP BY 
    is_peer_copycat;

SELECT
    ri.churnflag AS churn_risk_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.userregistry) AS fan_count,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(i.timemark))) / 3600) AS avg_time_since_last_activity_hours,
    AVG(e.engrate) AS avg_engagement,
    AVG(ps.intconsist) AS avg_interaction_consistency,
    AVG(ri.churnflag) AS avg_risk_score
FROM 
    RetentionAndInfluence ri
JOIN 
    MembershipAndSpending ms ON ri.retainloyaltypivot = ms.memberreg
JOIN 
    Fans f ON ms.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
LEFT JOIN 
    Interactions i ON f.userregistry = i.interactfanpivot
LEFT JOIN 
    Engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
LEFT JOIN 
    PreferencesAndSettings ps ON ms.memberreg = ps.preferencesmemberpivot
GROUP BY 
    ri.churnflag;

SELECT

    (venddisputecount * -0.2) +

FROM 
    vendors
WHERE 
    vendtxcount >= 1
ORDER BY 
    relationship_score DESC;

WITH qualifying_robots AS (

        jc.j2tempval AS joint_2_temperature,
        jc.j3tempval AS joint_3_temperature,
        jc.j4tempval AS joint_4_temperature,
        jc.j5tempval AS joint_5_temperature,
        jc.j6tempval AS joint_6_temperature,
        jc.j1vibval AS joint_1_vibration,
        jc.j2vibval AS joint_2_vibration,
        jc.j3vibval AS joint_3_vibration,
        jc.j4vibval AS joint_4_vibration,
        jc.j5vibval AS joint_5_vibration,
        jc.j6vibval AS joint_6_vibration,
        jc.j1backval AS joint_1_backlash,
        jc.j2backval AS joint_2_backlash,
        jc.j3backval AS joint_3_backlash,
        jc.j4backval AS joint_4_backlash,
        jc.j5backval AS joint_5_backlash,
        jc.j6backval AS joint_6_backlash
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    LEFT JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    LEFT JOIN 
        performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    LEFT JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    LEFT JOIN 
        joint_performance jp ON rd.botdetreg = jp.jperfdetref
    LEFT JOIN 
        joint_condition jc ON rd.botdetreg = jc.jcdetref
    WHERE 
        ps.conditionindexval > 1.5 
        AND (
            jc.j1tempval > 65 OR jc.j2tempval > 65 OR jc.j3tempval > 65 
            OR jc.j4tempval > 65 OR jc.j5tempval > 65 OR jc.j6tempval > 65
        )
        AND op.totopshrval > 5000
),
regression_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(total_operating_hours * joint_degradation_index) - SUM(total_operating_hours) * SUM(joint_degradation_index)) /
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(total_operating_hours * total_operating_hours) - POWER(SUM(total_operating_hours), 2)) AS regression_slope
    FROM 
        qualifying_robots
)

LEFT JOIN

WITH SiteAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) AS avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) AS avg_illumination
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteSuitability AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY AVG(se.ambictemp) + AVG(se.humepct) + AVG(se.illumelux)) AS suitability_quartile
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
),
SiteECC AS (
    SELECT 
        se.zoneref AS site_code,
        CASE 
            WHEN (AVG(se.ambictemp) + AVG(se.humepct) + AVG(se.illumelux)) > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN (AVG(se.ambictemp) + AVG(se.humepct) + AVG(se.illumelux)) BETWEEN 70 AND 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN (AVG(se.ambictemp) + AVG(se.humepct) + AVG(se.illumelux)) BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END AS eccs_category
    FROM 
        scanenvironment se
    GROUP BY 
        se.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    s.digunit AS excavation_unit,
    s.gridtrace AS grid_reference,
    s.geox AS latitude,
    s.geoy AS longitude,
    s.heightm AS altitude,
    s.depthc AS depth,
    s.phasefactor AS cultural_period,
    s.guessdate AS estimated_date,
    s.typesite AS site_type,
    s.presstat AS preservation_status,
    s.guardhint AS weather_protection,
    s.entrystat AS site_access_status,
    s.saferank AS security_level,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    s.riskeval AS risk_assessment_status,
    s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    s.envhaz AS environmental_risk,
    sa.avg_temperature,
    sa.avg_humidity,
    sa.avg_illumination,
    ss.suitability_quartile,
    sec.eccs_category
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    SiteAverages sa ON s.zoneregistry = sa.site_code
JOIN 
    SiteSuitability ss ON s.zoneregistry = ss.site_code
JOIN 
    SiteECC sec ON s.zoneregistry = sec.site_code;

WITH investigation_index AS (
    SELECT 
        compref, 
        ROUND(
            (0.6 * behansc) + (0.4 * netansc), 
            2
        ) AS iii
    FROM 
        investigationdetails
), 
network_mimic_traders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        trdref
    FROM 
        transactionrecord
    WHERE 
        risk_indicators @> '{"Networked Mimicry Risk": true}'
)

    c.*, 
    ii.iii AS investigation_index
FROM 
    compliancecase c
JOIN 
    investigation_index ii ON c.compreg = ii.compref
JOIN 
    network_mimic_traders nmt ON c.transref = nmt.trdref
ORDER BY 
    investigation_index DESC;

WITH maintenance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.growalias AS plant_name,
        p.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,
        SUM(m.maintcostusd) AS total_maintenance_cost,
        SUM(m.revlossusd) AS total_revenue_loss,
        (SUM(m.maintcostusd) / p.gencapmw) AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        (SUM(m.revlossusd) / p.gencapmw) AS revenue_loss_rate,
        ((SUM(m.revlossusd) / p.gencapmw) / (SUM(m.maintcostusd) / p.gencapmw)) AS mroi
    FROM 
        plant p
    JOIN 
        maintenance m ON p.growregistry = m.powerref
    GROUP BY 
        p.growalias, p.gencapmw
)
SELECT 
    plant_name,
    capacity_mw,
    total_maintenance_cost,
    total_revenue_loss,
    maintenance_cost_efficiency,
    revenue_loss_rate,
    mroi,
    CASE 
        WHEN mroi > 1.5 THEN 'URGENT'
        WHEN mroi BETWEEN 1 AND 1.5 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN mroi BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS priority_level
FROM 
    maintenance_metrics;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_performance_alert()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $ 
DECLARE 
    degradation_threshold NUMERIC := 0.7; -- 0.7% degradation per year
begin
    -- Check if the new performance entry indicates a degradation greater than the threshold
    IF NEW.efficiency_profile->>'anndegrate' > degradation_threshold THEN
        -- Check if a similar alert already exists
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM alerts a
            WHERE a.deviceref = NEW.solmodref
            AND a.alertstat = 'Critical'
            AND a.alertmoment >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month'
        ) THEN
            -- Update the existing alert
            UPDATE alerts
            SET alertmoment = NOW(), alertcnt = alertcnt + 1
            WHERE deviceref = NEW.solmodref
            AND alertstat = 'Critical';
        ELSE
            -- Insert a new critical performance alert
            INSERT INTO alerts (
                alertreg, compreg, deviceref, incidentref, alertmoment, alertstat, alertcnt, maintprior, replaceprior, optpotential
            )
            VALUES (
                uuid_generate_v4(),
                (SELECT hubregistry FROM panel WHERE panemark = NEW.solmodref),
                NEW.solmodref,
                NEW.perfregistry,
                NOW(),
                'Critical',
                1,
                'High',
                'High',
                'Medium'
            );
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Create a trigger that fires after each insert on the performance table
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_performance_alert
AFTER INSERT ON performance
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION generate_performance_alert();

WITH SignalMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
        AVG(CAST(REPLACE(rp.analysisprio, 'High', '3') AS FLOAT)) AS avg_priority_score,
        AVG(sp.corrscore) AS avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'Important' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS important_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sp.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_signals,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rp.analysisprio = 'Important' AND sp.corrscore > 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_criteria_signals
    FROM 
        telescopes t
    JOIN 
        signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN 
        researchprocess rp ON s.signalregistry = rp.signalref
    JOIN 
        signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    GROUP BY 
        t.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    total_signal_count,
    avg_priority_score,
    avg_confirmation_confidence_score,
    important_signals,
    high_confidence_signals,
    both_criteria_signals
FROM 
    SignalMetrics
ORDER BY 
    both_criteria_signals DESC, high_confidence_signals DESC, important_signals DESC, avg_priority_score DESC;

WITH bsi AS (

        recordregistry AS flow_id, 
        bwidthpct * (datasizemb / durmin) AS bsi
    FROM dataflow
), 
flow_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        recordregistry AS flow_id, 
        successpct / (1 - errtally / (errtally + rtrytally)) AS data_transfer_efficiency
    FROM dataflow
)
SELECT 
    b.flow_id, 
    b.bsi AS bandwidth_saturation_index, 
    f.data_transfer_efficiency
FROM bsi b
JOIN flow_efficiency f ON b.flow_id = f.flow_id

LIMIT 10;

WITH bsi AS (

WITH battery_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.makername AS maker_name,
        t1.modnum AS model,
        t2.battlifeh AS battery_life,
        t2.battcapmah AS battery_capacity,
        t1.pwractmw AS power_draw,
        (t2.battlifeh * t1.pwractmw) / t2.battcapmah AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (t2.battlifeh * t1.pwractmw) / t2.battcapmah) AS battery_efficiency_classification,
        NTILE(100) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.makername ORDER BY (t2.battlifeh * t1.pwractmw) / t2.battcapmah) AS maker_percentile_ranking
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
    WHERE 
        t1.conntype ILIKE '%wireless%'
)
SELECT 
    maker_name,
    model,
    battery_life,
    battery_capacity,
    power_draw,
    battery_efficiency_ratio,
    battery_efficiency_classification
FROM 
    battery_efficiency
ORDER BY 
    maker_name, battery_efficiency_ratio DESC;

WITH robot_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        SUM(op.progcyclecount) AS total_program_cycles,
        SUM(op.cycletimesecval) / COUNT(op.operreg) AS avg_cycle_time,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.currprogval) AS unique_programs,
        op.totopshrval AS operation_time
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    GROUP BY 
        rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, op.totopshrval
),
robot_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.*,
        (total_program_cycles / SUM(total_program_cycles) OVER (PARTITION BY model_series)) AS efficiency_score
    FROM 
        robot_metrics rm
),
robot_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        re.*, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY model_series ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC) AS efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        robot_efficiency re
)
SELECT 
    rr.robot_id,
    rr.model_series,
    rr.total_program_cycles AS tpc,
    rr.avg_cycle_time,
    rr.unique_programs,
    rr.operation_time,
    rr.efficiency_score AS oce,
    rr.efficiency_rank
FROM 
    robot_ranking rr
WHERE 
    rr.total_program_cycles > (SELECT AVG(total_program_cycles) FROM robot_metrics)
ORDER BY 
    rr.efficiency_rank ASC;

WITH erps AS (
    SELECT 
        (t1."Display Safety Duration (DSD)" - t2.displaydurmonths) * (t1."Light Exposure Risk (LER)" + 1) * (t1."Conservation Priority Index (CPI)" + 1) / 100 AS erps,
        t2.artrefused,
        t2.displaydurmonths,
        t1."Display Safety Duration (DSD)"
    FROM 
        external_knowledge AS t1
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS t2 ON t1."Display Safety Duration (DSD)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    t3.artregistry AS "Artifact ID",
    t3.artname AS "Artifact Name",
    t3.mattype AS "Material Type",
    erps.displaydurmonths AS "Current Display Duration",
    erps."Display Safety Duration (DSD)" AS "Display Limit",
    erps.erps AS "Calculated Score",
    CASE 
        WHEN erps.erps < 50 THEN 'Immediate Rotation'
        ELSE 'Monitor'
    END AS Recommendation
FROM 
    erps
JOIN 
    artifactscore AS t3 ON erps.artrefused = t3.artregistry
WHERE 
    t3.conservestatus = 'Active';

WITH sse_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        a.abkey, 
        (
            SUM(
                CASE 
                    WHEN asd.socsup = 'Strong' THEN 3 
                    WHEN asd.socsup = 'Moderate' THEN 2 
                    WHEN asd.socsup = 'Limited' THEN 1 
                    ELSE 0 
                END + 
                CASE 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Good' THEN 3 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Fair' THEN 2 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Poor' THEN 1 
                    WHEN asd.relqual = 'Conflicted' THEN 0 
                    ELSE 0 
                END
            )
        ) / COUNT(*) AS sse_score
    FROM 
        assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics AS a ON asd.asdkey = a.abkey
    GROUP BY 
        a.abkey
),
patient_missed_appointments AS (
    SELECT 
        e.patref, 
        AVG(e.missappt) AS avg_missed_appointments
    FROM 
        encounters AS e
    GROUP BY 
        e.patref
),
latest_sse_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        a.patownerref, 
        s.sse_score, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.patownerref ORDER BY a.abkey DESC) AS row_num
    FROM 
        assessmentbasics AS a
    JOIN 
        sse_scores AS s ON a.abkey = s.abkey
)
SELECT 
    p.patkey, 
    pma.avg_missed_appointments, 
    lss.sse_score
FROM 
    patients AS p
JOIN 
    patient_missed_appointments AS pma ON p.patkey = pma.patref
JOIN 
    latest_sse_scores AS lss ON p.patkey = lss.patownerref
WHERE 
    lss.row_num = 1
AND 
    lss.sse_score < 3
ORDER BY 
    p.patkey;

    coolkind,
    coolmass,
    coolremainpct,
    coolrefills,
    refilllatest,
    refillnext,
    batterypct,
    pwrfeed,
    pwrbackupflag,
    (100 - coolremainpct) AS coolant_usage,
    CASE 
        WHEN (100 - coolremainpct) > 50 THEN 'High Depletion' 
        ELSE 'Low Depletion' 
    END AS depletion_status
FROM 
    container;

WITH uer_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        seshstart,
        (seshviews * engscore / seshdur) AS uer
    FROM 
        sessions
),
daily_avg_uer AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(seshstart) AS session_date,
        AVG(uer) AS avg_uer
    FROM 
        uer_calc
    GROUP BY 
        session_date
)
SELECT 
    uer_calc.seshstart AS session_date,
    uer_calc.uer AS calculated_uer,
    daily_avg_uer.avg_uer AS daily_avg_uer
FROM 
    uer_calc
JOIN 
    daily_avg_uer ON DATE(uer_calc.seshstart) = daily_avg_uer.session_date
WHERE 
    uer_calc.uer > daily_avg_uer.avg_uer
ORDER BY 
    uer_calc.seshstart;

WITH status AS (
  SELECT 
    a.artregistry, 
    a.artname,

WITH ranked_stations AS (
    SELECT 
        o.observstation AS observatory_name,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS signal_count,
        AVG(sp.anomscore) AS avg_origin_score,
        AVG(s.freqmhz / s.bwhz) AS avg_frequency_ratio,
        COUNT(s.signalregistry) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(s.signalregistry)) OVER () AS percentage_candidates,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY COUNT(s.signalregistry) DESC
        ) AS rank
    FROM 
        observatories o
    JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
    JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    WHERE 
        sp.falseposprob < 0.01
    GROUP BY 
        o.observstation
)
SELECT 
    observatory_name,
    signal_count,
    avg_origin_score,
    avg_frequency_ratio,
    percentage_candidates
FROM 
    ranked_stations
ORDER BY 
    rank;

WITH SensorMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.containlink, 
        MAX(sd.tempdevcount) AS max_tempdevcount, 
        MAX(sd.critevents) AS max_critevents, 
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_tempstabidx, 
        -- Assuming 'alertkind' contains status information
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sd.alertkind, ', ') AS sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        SensorData sd
    GROUP BY 
        sd.containlink
),
ContainerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry, 
        c.coolremainpct, 
        -- Assuming 'coolremainpct' is the coolant percentage remaining
        sm.max_tempdevcount, 
        sm.max_critevents, 
        sm.max_tempstabidx, 
        sm.sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        Container c
    LEFT JOIN 
        SensorMetrics sm ON c.containregistry = sm.containlink
),
RiskMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.containregistry, 
        cm.coolremainpct, 
        cm.max_tempdevcount, 
        cm.max_critevents, 
        cm.max_tempstabidx, 
        cm.sensor_data_status, 
        -- Assuming 'Container Risk Index (CRI)' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('ContainerRiskIndex', cm.containregistry) AS cri, 
        -- Assuming 'Temperature Breach Severity (TBS)' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('TemperatureBreachSeverity', cm.containregistry) AS tbs, 
        -- Assuming 'Risk Rank' is a known external metric
        EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('RiskRank', cm.containregistry) AS risk_rank
    FROM 
        ContainerMetrics cm
),
FinalResults AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.containregistry AS container_id, 
        rm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temp_stability_score, 
        rm.cri AS container_risk_index, 
        rm.risk_rank, 
        rm.sensor_data_status, 
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'TempDevCount', rm.max_tempdevcount,
            'CritEvents', rm.max_critevents,
            'TempStabIdx', rm.max_tempstabidx,
            'CoolRemainPct', rm.coolremainpct,
            'TempBreachSeverity', rm.tbs
        ) AS diagnostic_summary
    FROM 
        RiskMetrics rm
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    max_temp_stability_score, 
    container_risk_index, 
    risk_rank, 
    sensor_data_status, 
    diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    FinalResults
ORDER BY 
    risk_rank DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    t1.envhealthregistry AS "Environmental Registry",
    t2.affectedarea AS "Affected Area",
    t2.haztype AS "Hazard Type",
    (t1.carbontons * (100 - t1.renewenergypct) * (100 - t1.recyclepct)) AS "Environmental Footprint Factor",
    CASE
        WHEN (t1.carbontons * (100 - t1.renewenergypct) * (100 - t1.recyclepct)) < 100 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN (t1.carbontons * (100 - t1.renewenergypct) * (100 - t1.recyclepct)) BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS "Environmental Impact Classification"
FROM
    environmentandhealth AS t1
JOIN
    disasterevents AS t2 ON t1.envdistref = t2.distregistry
ORDER BY
    "Environmental Footprint Factor";

WITH SensorMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.containlink, 
        MAX(sd.tempdevcount) AS max_tempdevcount, 
        MAX(sd.critevents) AS max_critevents, 
        MAX(sd.tempstabidx) AS max_tempstabidx, 
        -- Assuming 'alertkind' contains status information
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sd.alertkind, ', ') AS sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        sensordata sd
    GROUP BY 
        sd.containlink
),
ContainerMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry, 
        c.coolremainpct, 
        -- Assuming 'coolremainpct' is the coolant percentage remaining
        sm.max_tempdevcount, 
        sm.max_critevents, 
        sm.max_tempstabidx, 
        sm.sensor_data_status
    FROM 
        container c
    LEFT JOIN 
        SensorMetrics sm ON c.containregistry = sm.containlink
),
RiskMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.containregistry, 
        cm.coolremainpct, 
        cm.max_tempdevcount, 
        cm.max_critevents, 
        cm.max_tempstabidx, 
        cm.sensor_data_status, 
        -- Assuming 'Container Risk Index (CRI)' is calculated based on available data
        (cm.max_tempdevcount + cm.max_critevents) AS cri, 
        -- Assuming 'Temperature Breach Severity (TBS)' is calculated based on available data
        (cm.max_tempdevcount * cm.max_critevents) AS tbs, 
        -- Assuming 'Risk Rank' is calculated based on available data
        (cm.max_tempdevcount + cm.max_critevents + cm.max_tempstabidx) AS risk_rank
    FROM 
        ContainerMetrics cm
),
FinalResults AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.containregistry AS container_id, 
        rm.max_tempstabidx AS max_temp_stability_score, 
        rm.cri AS container_risk_index, 
        rm.risk_rank, 
        rm.sensor_data_status, 
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'TempDevCount', rm.max_tempdevcount,
            'CritEvents', rm.max_critevents,
            'TempStabIdx', rm.max_tempstabidx,
            'CoolRemainPct', rm.coolremainpct,
            'TempBreachSeverity', rm.tbs
        ) AS diagnostic_summary
    FROM 
        RiskMetrics rm
)
SELECT 
    container_id, 
    max_temp_stability_score, 
    container_risk_index, 
    risk_rank, 
    sensor_data_status, 
    diagnostic_summary
FROM 
    FinalResults
ORDER BY 
    risk_rank DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT

    f.ptsval AS contribution_score,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(sc.community_engagement, 'group_involvement', 'grprole') AS group_role,
    e.actfreq AS activity_frequency,
    ms.membdays AS membership_duration
FROM 
    fans f
JOIN 
    socialcommunity sc ON f.userregistry = sc.socialreg
JOIN 
    engagement e ON sc.socialengagepivot = e.engagereg
JOIN 
    membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
ORDER BY

SELECT 
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.powratew AS power_ratings,
    perf.measpoww AS current_power,
    perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS degradation,
    env.soillosspct AS soiling_loss,
    inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS inverter_losses,
    -- Calculate Total System Loss (TSL) per panel using Inverter Efficiency Loss (IEL)
    (
        (p.powratew * (1 - perf.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct'::float/100))
        * (1 - env.soillosspct/100)
        * (1 - inv.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct'::float/100)
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    panel p
JOIN 
    performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref
JOIN 
    environment env ON p.hubregistry = env.arearegistry
JOIN 
    inverter inv ON p.hubregistry = inv.siteref
LIMIT 10;

JOIN 
    regulatoryandmaintenance AS rm ON s.shipmentregistry = rm.shipgov
WHERE 
    s.integritymark = 'Compromised'
GROUP BY 
    s.shipmentregistry, s.integritymark
ORDER BY 
    incident_count DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_market_risk(
    p_dlyflow BIGINT,
    p_esccomprate NUMERIC,
    p_interscore NUMERIC,
    p_vendcount INTEGER,
    p_mktspan INTEGER
)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        p_dlyflow / 1000.0 +
        (p_esccomprate * 0.2) +
        (p_interscore * 0.3) +
        (p_vendcount * 0.1) -
        (p_mktspan / 100.0)
    );
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH vti AS (
    SELECT
        vendregistry,
        (vendsucccount / vendtxcount) * 100 - (venddisputecount / vendtxcount) * 50 + (vendrate * 5) AS vendor_trust_index
    FROM vendors
)
SELECT
    v.*,
    vti.vendor_trust_index
FROM
    vendors v
JOIN
    markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
JOIN
    vti ON v.vendregistry = vti.vendregistry
WHERE
    m.market_status_reputation->>'trust_level' = 'High'
ORDER BY
    v.vendregistry;

WITH high_risk_patients AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.patownerref AS patient_id
    FROM 
        "mental".assessmentbasics AS ab
    JOIN 
        "mental".assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr
    ON 
        ab.abkey = asr.asrkey
    WHERE 
        asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')
        OR (asr.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::INT > 15
        OR (asr.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::INT > 15
),
very_risky_encounters AS (
    SELECT 
        e.enckey AS encounter_id,
        e.timemark AS encounter_timestamp,
        e.patref AS patient_id,
        e.clinid AS clinician_id,
        e.facid AS facility_id,
        e.missappt AS missed_appointments,
        e.txbarrier AS treatment_barriers,
        e.nxapptdt AS next_appointment_date,
        e.dqscore AS data_quality_score,
        e.assesscomplete AS assessment_completeness
    FROM 
        "mental".encounters AS e
    JOIN 
        high_risk_patients AS hr
    ON 
        e.patref = hr.patient_id
)
SELECT 
    v.encounter_id,
    v.encounter_timestamp,
    v.patient_id,
    v.clinician_id,
    v.facility_id,
    v.missed_appointments,
    v.treatment_barriers,
    v.next_appointment_date,
    v.data_quality_score,
    v.assessment_completeness
INTO 
    audit_table
FROM 
    very_risky_encounters AS v;

SELECT 
    t.transportregistry AS transport_registry_id,
    (
        (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
        (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
        (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
        (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
        (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
            WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
        (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
        (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
            WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END +
        (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
        CASE 
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
            WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
            ELSE 0
        END -
        (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
    ) AS lpm_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN (
            (t.vehiclecount * 0.2) +
            (t.trucksavailable * 0.2) +
            (t.helosavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.boatsavailable * 0.15) +
            (t.totaldeliverytons * 0.1) +
            (t.dailydeliverytons * 0.1) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'On Track' THEN 10
                WHEN t.lastmilestatus = 'Delayed' THEN 5
                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.distributionpoints * 0.05) +
            (100 / (1 + t.avgdeliveryhours)) * 0.05 +
            (t.deliverysuccessrate * 0.05) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'Optimized' THEN 5
                WHEN t.routeoptstatus = 'In Progress' THEN 3
                ELSE 0
            END +
            (t.fuelefficiencylpk * 0.03) +
            CASE 
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Up to Date' THEN 5
                WHEN t.maintenancestate = 'Due' THEN 2
                ELSE 0
            END -
            (t.vehiclebreakrate * 0.02)
        ) < 50 THEN 'Logistics Breakdown'
        ELSE 'Normal Operation'
    END AS status
FROM

    CASE

      WHEN t1.atmostransparency BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5

CREATE TYPE battery_efficiency_enum AS ENUM ('Low', 'Medium', 'High');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE (device_id VARCHAR, efficiency_value NUMERIC, efficiency_classification battery_efficiency_enum)
AS $ 
DECLARE
    batt_percentage SMALLINT;
    batt_life NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        t2.devregistry AS device_id,
        (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) AS efficiency_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) < 0.5 THEN 'Low'::battery_efficiency_enum
            WHEN (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) >= 0.5 AND (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) < 1.0 THEN 'Medium'::battery_efficiency_enum
            ELSE 'High'::battery_efficiency_enum
        END AS efficiency_classification
    FROM 
        testsessions AS t1
    JOIN 
        deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.sessionregistry = t2.devsessionref
    WHERE 
        t2.conntype IN ('Wireless', 'Bluetooth');
END;
$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH health_resilience_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        distregistry AS registry_id,
        (
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN "medicalEmergencyCapacity" = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN "medicalEmergencyCapacity" = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN "medicalEmergencyCapacity" = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 1' THEN 5
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 2' THEN 4
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 4' THEN 2
                    WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 5' THEN 1
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN "hazlevel" = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score,
        (
            ("diseaserisk" = 'High') AND (waterqualityindex < 50) AND (PHRS < 40)
        ) AS is_public_health_emergency,
        (
            ("diseaserisk" = 'High') 
            AND (waterqualityindex < 50) 
            AND (PHRS < 40)
            AND (health_resilience_score < 30)
            AND (staffingProfile->>'ppe_status' = 'Critical')
        ) AS is_critical_health_response_required
    FROM 
        "environmentandhealth" AS eh
    INNER JOIN disasterevents AS de ON de.distregistry = eh.envdistref
)
SELECT 
    registry_id,
    health_resilience_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN is_critical_health_response_required THEN 'Health Crisis'
        ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
    END AS health_status
FROM 
    health_resilience_scores
ORDER BY 
    registry_id;

WITH tenure_quartiles AS (

        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY tenureyrs) AS tenure_quartile
    FROM core_record
),
customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.clientref, 
        tq.tenure_quartile AS cohort_quarter
    FROM core_record cr
    JOIN tenure_quartiles tq ON TRUE
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        bat.bankexpref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN cidb.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' 
            AND cidb.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High' THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_digital_native
    FROM bank_and_transactions bat
    JOIN expenses_and_assets eaa ON bat.bankexpref = eaa.expemplref
    JOIN employment_and_income eai ON eaa.expemplref = eai.emplcoreref
    JOIN core_record cr ON eai.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT chaninvdatablock
    ) AS cidb
),
engagement_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.clientref, 
        -- Assuming 'chanusescore' is the engagement score
        cah.chanusescore AS engagement_score
    FROM core_record cr
    JOIN employment_and_income eai ON cr.coreregistry = eai.emplcoreref
    JOIN expenses_and_assets eaa ON eai.emplcoreref = eaa.expemplref
    JOIN bank_and_transactions bat ON eaa.expemplref = bat.bankexpref
    JOIN credit_and_compliance cac ON bat.bankexpref = cac.compbankref
    JOIN credit_accounts_and_history cah ON cac.compbankref = cah.histcompref
),
cohort_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.cohort_quarter, 
        dn.is_digital_native, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT cc.clientref) AS cohort_size, 
        AVG(es.engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN es.engagement_score > 0.7 THEN cc.clientref END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cc.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    LEFT JOIN digital_natives dn ON cc.clientref = dn.bankexpref
    LEFT JOIN engagement_scores es ON cc.clientref = es.clientref
    GROUP BY cc.cohort_quarter, dn.is_digital_native
)
SELECT 
    ca.cohort_quarter, 
    ca.is_digital_native, 
    ca.cohort_size, 
    ca.avg_engagement_score, 
    ca.high_engagement_percentage
FROM cohort_analysis ca
ORDER BY ca.cohort_quarter, ca.is_digital_native DESC;

WITH TopPositions AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.riskandmarginpivot, 
        o.notionsum AS notional_value, 
        ms.volmeter AS volatility_measure, 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'inithold' AS initial_margin, 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'mainthold' AS maintenance_margin, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.notionsum DESC) AS position_rank
    FROM 
        riskandmargin rm
    JOIN 
        orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON rm.riskandmarginpivot = ms.marketstatsmark
    WHERE 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'possum' IS NOT NULL 
        AND o.notionsum IS NOT NULL 
        AND ms.volmeter IS NOT NULL
),
PVaRCalculation AS (
    SELECT 
        riskandmarginpivot, 
        notional_value, 
        volatility_measure, 
        initial_margin, 
        maintenance_margin, 
        (
            (notional_value * volatility_measure) - 
            (initial_margin + maintenance_margin)
        ) AS pvar
    FROM 
        TopPositions
    WHERE 
        position_rank <= 5
)
SELECT 
    pvar AS risk_and_margin_pivot, 
    notional_value, 
    volatility_measure, 
    pvar AS calculated_pvar
FROM 
    PVaRCalculation;

    END) * (
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'Critical' THEN 1
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'High' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.curerank = 'Low' THEN 10
    END) * (
    CASE 
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Stable' THEN 10
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Moderate' THEN 5
        WHEN sc.structstate = 'Unstable' THEN 1
    END) AS quality_index
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanconservation sc ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
ORDER BY 
    quality_index DESC;

WITH ser_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        vd.containvac, 
        CASE 
            WHEN c.volliters > 0 AND vd.vialtally > 0 
            THEN (vd.vialtally * 10.0) / c.volliters 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS ser
    FROM 
        vaccinedetails AS vd
    JOIN 
        container AS c ON vd.containvac = c.containregistry
),
tss_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.containlink, 
        (sd.tempstabidx * exp(-sd.tempdevcount)) / (sd.critevents + 1) AS tss
    FROM 
        sensordata AS sd
)

UPDATE 
    container AS c
SET 
    containflag = 'Highly Utilized'
FROM 
    ser_cte AS ser, 
    tss_cte AS tss
WHERE 
    c.containregistry = ser.containvac
    AND c.containregistry = tss.containlink
    AND c.containflag = 'Active'
    AND ser.ser > 0.8
    AND tss.tss > 0.9;

SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer,
    d.modnum AS model,
    ts.devscope AS device_type,
    r.rgbbright AS rgb_brightness,
    r.rgbcoloracc AS color_accuracy,
    r.rgbzones AS number_of_rgb_zones,
    r.rgbmodes AS rgb_modes,
    r.rgbcolors AS supported_colors,
    -- Calculate RGB Implementation Quality Score
    (
        r.rgbbright * 0.2 + 
        r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + 
        r.rgbzones * 0.15 + 
        r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + 
        r.rgbcolors * 0.2
    ) AS rgb_implementation_quality_score,
    -- Classify RGB Quality based on the calculated score
    CASE
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) > 8.0 THEN 'Premium RGB Implementation'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0 THEN 'High-Quality RGB'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.9 THEN 'Standard RGB'
        ELSE 'Basic RGB'
    END AS rgb_classification
FROM 
    deviceidentity d
JOIN 
    testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN 
    rgb r ON d.devregistry = r.rgbregistry
ORDER BY 
    rgb_implementation_quality_score DESC;

WITH TopPositions AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.riskandmarginpivot, 
        o.notionsum AS notional_value, 
        ms.volmeter AS volatility_measure, 
        CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->>'inithold' AS NUMERIC) AS initial_margin, 
        CAST(rm.risk_margin_profile->>'mainthold' AS NUMERIC) AS maintenance_margin, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.notionsum DESC) AS position_rank
    FROM 
        riskandmargin rm
    JOIN 
        orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON rm.riskandmarginpivot = ms.marketstatsmark
    WHERE 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'possum' IS NOT NULL 
        AND o.notionsum IS NOT NULL 
        AND ms.volmeter IS NOT NULL
),
PVaRCalculation AS (
    SELECT 
        riskandmarginpivot, 
        notional_value, 
        volatility_measure, 
        initial_margin, 
        maintenance_margin, 
        (
            (notional_value * volatility_measure) - 
            (initial_margin + maintenance_margin)
        ) AS pvar
    FROM 
        TopPositions
    WHERE 
        position_rank <= 5
)
SELECT 
    pvar AS risk_and_margin_pivot, 
    notional_value, 
    volatility_measure, 
    pvar AS calculated_pvar
FROM 
    PVaRCalculation;

WITH EfficiencyMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        sp.flowsoft AS processing_software,
        sp.flowstage AS processing_stage,
        sp.flowhrs AS avg_processing_hours,
        AVG(sp.proccpu) AS avg_cpu_usage,
        AVG(sp.procgpu) AS avg_gpu_usage,
        AVG(s.gbsize) AS avg_data_size_gb,
        AVG(
            (s.gbsize * LOG10(COALESCE(spc.totalpts, 1000000))) /
            (sp.flowhrs * ((AVG(sp.proccpu) + AVG(sp.procgpu)) / 200))
        ) AS avg_efficiency_value,
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(
                (s.gbsize * LOG10(COALESCE(spc.totalpts, 1000000))) /
                (sp.flowhrs * ((AVG(sp.proccpu) + AVG(sp.procgpu)) / 200))
            ) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck'
            ELSE 'Efficient'
        END AS efficiency_status,
        COUNT(*) AS total_workflows
    FROM
        scanprocessing sp
    JOIN
        scans s ON sp.flowregistry = s.questregistry
    JOIN
        scanpointcloud spc ON sp.flowregistry = spc.cloudregistry
    GROUP BY
        sp.flowsoft, sp.flowstage, sp.flowhrs
)
SELECT
    processing_software,
    processing_stage,
    avg_processing_hours,
    avg_cpu_usage,
    avg_gpu_usage,
    avg_data_size_gb,
    avg_efficiency_value,
    efficiency_status,
    total_workflows
FROM
    EfficiencyMetrics;

            ELSE 'NORMAL'
        END AS tool_status
    FROM

WITH safety_scores AS (
    SELECT

                    WHEN ps.safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Emergency' THEN 0
                    WHEN ps.safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Warning' THEN 5
                    WHEN ps.safety_metrics->>'safety_state' = 'Normal' THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'load_value'::FLOAT > 80 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'load_value'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'load_value'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'memory_usage'::FLOAT > 80 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'memory_usage'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'memory_usage'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10
                END) +
            5 * (CASE 
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::FLOAT > 80 THEN 0
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10

                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_humidity'::FLOAT BETWEEN 50 AND 70 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_humidity'::FLOAT < 50 THEN 10

                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_temperature'::FLOAT BETWEEN 25 AND 40 THEN 5
                    WHEN sc.controller_metrics->>'cabinet_temperature'::FLOAT < 25 THEN 10

        ) AS safety_score
    FROM 
        performance_and_safety ps
    JOIN 
        system_controller sc ON ps.effectivenessrobot = sc.systemoverseerrobot

    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0.1 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users)
),

FROM average_scores

    AND average_scores.gender = usv_uds.gender
    AND average_scores.occupation = usv_uds.occupation

                ELSE 1.2 -- Default weight factor for other levels
            END
        ) AS readability_score
    FROM articles
),
average_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        AVG(readability_score) AS avg_readability_score,
        AVG(engagement_rate::FLOAT) AS avg_engagement_rate
    FROM article_metrics
    GROUP BY article_category
),
complexity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        complexity_level,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM article_metrics
    GROUP BY complexity_level
),
correlation_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CORR(readability_score, engagement_rate::FLOAT) AS correlation_coefficient
    FROM article_metrics
)
SELECT 
    am.article_category,
    am.avg_readability_score,
    am.avg_engagement_rate,
    cm.correlation_coefficient,
    cc.complexity_level, 
    cc.article_count
FROM 
    average_metrics am
CROSS JOIN 
    correlation_metrics cm
LEFT JOIN 
    complexity_counts cc ON cc.complexity_level = ANY(ARRAY['Basic', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced'])
ORDER BY 
    am.article_category;

        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(cbe.value) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        riskassessments r ON a.artregistry = r.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    JOIN 
        "Conservation Budget Efficiency (CBE)" cbe ON a.artregistry = cbe.artifact_id
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
AllDynastiesSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS Dynasty,
        SUM(TotalPriorityScore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) > 0 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyBudgetStatus
)

    FROM

        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(ac.CBE) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        riskassessments r ON a.artregistry = r.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    JOIN

    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
AllDynastiesSummary AS (

        SUM(TotalPriorityScore) AS TotalPriorityScore,

    (0.4 * ti.vpnratio) + (0.3 * (ti.proxycount / 10)) + (0.3 * (ti.ipcountrynum / 20)) AS technical_evasion_metric,
    CASE
        WHEN (0.4 * ti.vpnratio) + (0.3 * (ti.proxycount / 10)) + (0.3 * (ti.ipcountrynum / 20)) < 0.3 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN (0.4 * ti.vpnratio) + (0.3 * (ti.proxycount / 10)) + (0.3 * (ti.ipcountrynum / 20)) < 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS risk_level
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    technicalinfo ti ON a.accindex = ti.techkey;

SELECT

    PERCENTILE_DISC(
        (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

        ) / (

        ) * 100
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spreadrate) AS percentile_ranking

WITH sensitivity_summary AS (
    SELECT
        artref,
        json_build_object(
            'envsensitivity', envsensitivity,
            'lightsensitivity', lightsensitivity,
            'tempsensitivity', tempsensitivity,
            'humiditysensitivity', humiditysensitivity,
            'vibrasensitivity', vibrasensitivity,
            'pollutantsensitivity', pollutantsensitivity,
            'pestsensitivity', pestsensitivity,
            'handlesensitivity', handlesensitivity,
            'transportsensitivity', transportsensitivity,
            'displaysensitivity', displaysensitivity,
            'storagesensitivity', storagesensitivity
        ) AS sensitivity_json
    FROM sensitivitydata
),
risk_scores AS (
    SELECT
        artref,
        (
            (CASE WHEN envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN envsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN tempsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN humiditysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN vibrasensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN pollutantsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN pestsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN handlesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN transportsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN displaysensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END) +
            (CASE WHEN storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 WHEN storagesensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 ELSE 1 END)
        ) / 11.0 AS risk_factor
    FROM sensitivitydata
)
SELECT
    a.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    a.artname AS artifact_name,
    r.risk_factor,
    s.sensitivity_json
FROM
    artifactscore a
JOIN
    risk_scores r ON a.artregistry = r.artref
JOIN
    sensitivity_summary s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
WHERE
    r.risk_factor > 7
ORDER BY
    r.risk_factor DESC;

WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        clientref, 
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM scoredate) * 100 + EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM scoredate)) - (tenureyrs / 4) AS cohort_quarter
    FROM 
        core_record
),
digital_natives AS (
    SELECT 
        c.clientref
    FROM 
        bank_and_transactions b
    JOIN 
        expenses_and_assets e ON b.bankexpref = e.expemplref
    JOIN 
        employment_and_income i ON e.expemplref = i.emplcoreref
    JOIN 
        core_record c ON i.emplcoreref = c.coreregistry
    WHERE 
        (b.chaninvdatablock->>'onlineuse' = 'High' OR b.chaninvdatablock->>'mobileuse' = 'High')
        AND b.chaninvdatablock->>'autopay' = 'Yes'
),
cohort_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.cohort_quarter,
        dn.clientref IS NOT NULL AS is_digital_native,
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(ces.ces) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 AND dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN cr.clientref END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN 
        core_record cr ON qc.clientref = cr.clientref
    LEFT JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            c.coreregistry AS clientref, 
            ext."Customer Engagement Score (CES)" AS ces
        FROM 
            core_record c
        CROSS JOIN 
            all_external_knowledge ext
    ) ces ON cr.clientref = ces.clientref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.cohort_quarter, dn.clientref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    cohort_quarter,
    is_digital_native,
    cohort_size,
    avg_engagement_score,
    high_engagement_percentage,
    high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
FROM 
    cohort_engagement;

WITH RobotMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS number_of_robots,
        AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
        AVG(op.progcyclecount) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'most_efficient_program', (
                SELECT op_inner.currprogval
                FROM operation AS op_inner
                JOIN performance_and_safety AS ps_inner ON op_inner.operreg = ps_inner.effectivenessoperation
                WHERE op_inner.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg
                ORDER BY ps_inner.effectivenessindexval DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            'avg_OCE', AVG(ps.safety_metrics->>'OCE')
        ) AS program_metrics,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ps.effectivenessindexval < AVG(ps.effectivenessindexval) OVER (PARTITION BY rd.modelseriesval) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS underperforming_robots
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        operation AS op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety AS ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval
),
RankedRobotMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_cycle_time ASC) AS cycle_rank
    FROM 
        RobotMetrics
)
SELECT 
    model_series, number_of_robots, avg_cycle_time, avg_programs_per_robot, program_metrics, underperforming_robots
FROM 
    RankedRobotMetrics
WHERE 
    cycle_rank = 1
LIMIT 1;

),
cohort_engagement AS (

        dn.clientref IS NOT NULL AS is_digital_native,
        COUNT(cr.clientref) AS cohort_size,
        AVG(ces.ces) AS avg_engagement_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cr.clientref) AS high_engagement_percentage,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ces.ces > 0.7 AND dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN dn.clientref IS NOT NULL THEN cr.clientref END), 0) AS high_engagement_percentage_digital_native
    FROM 
        quarterly_cohorts qc
    JOIN 
        core_record cr ON qc.clientref = cr.clientref
    LEFT JOIN 
        digital_natives dn ON cr.clientref = dn.clientref
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            c.coreregistry AS clientref, 
            ext.definition->>'Customer Engagement Score (CES)'::float AS ces
        FROM 
            core_record c
        CROSS JOIN 
            get_all_knowledge_definitions() ext
    ) ces ON cr.clientref = ces.clientref
    GROUP BY 
        qc.cohort_quarter, dn.clientref IS NOT NULL
)

WITH RobotMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS number_of_robots,
        AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS avg_cycle_time,
        AVG(op.progcyclecount) AS avg_programs_per_robot,
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'most_efficient_program', (
                SELECT op_inner.currprogval
                FROM operation AS op_inner
                JOIN performance_and_safety AS ps_inner ON op_inner.operreg = ps_inner.effectivenessoperation
                WHERE op_inner.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg
                ORDER BY ps_inner.effectivenessindexval DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            'avg_OCE', AVG(CAST(ps.safety_metrics->>'OCE' AS NUMERIC))
        ) AS program_metrics,
        -- Calculate underperforming robots based on average effectivenessindexval for each model series
        SUM(CASE WHEN ps.effectivenessindexval < avg_effectiveness.avg_eff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS underperforming_robots
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        operation AS op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN 
        performance_and_safety AS ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    -- Join with subquery to get average effectivenessindexval for each model series
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            modelseriesval, 
            AVG(effectivenessindexval) AS avg_eff
        FROM 
            performance_and_safety
        GROUP BY 
            modelseriesval
    ) AS avg_effectiveness ON rd.modelseriesval = avg_effectiveness.modelseriesval
    GROUP BY 
        rd.modelseriesval, avg_effectiveness.avg_eff
),
RankedRobotMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_cycle_time ASC) AS cycle_rank
    FROM 
        RobotMetrics
)
SELECT 
    model_series, number_of_robots, avg_cycle_time, avg_programs_per_robot, program_metrics, underperforming_robots
FROM 
    RankedRobotMetrics
WHERE 
    cycle_rank = 1
LIMIT 1;

WITH maintenance_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.growalias AS plant_name,
        t1.gencapmw AS capacity_mw,

        SUM(t2.revlossusd) AS revenue_losses,
        (SUM(t2.maintcostusd) + SUM(t2.cleancostusd) + SUM(t2.replacecostusd)) / t1.gencapmw AS maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        SUM(t2.revlossusd) / SUM(t2.maintcostusd) AS revenue_loss_rate,
        (SUM(t2.revlossusd) / SUM(t2.maintcostusd)) / ((SUM(t2.maintcostusd) + SUM(t2.cleancostusd) + SUM(t2.replacecostusd)) / t1.gencapmw) AS mroi
    FROM 
        plant AS t1
    JOIN 
        maintenance AS t2 ON t1.growregistry = t2.powerref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.growalias, t1.gencapmw
),
priority_levels AS (
    SELECT 
        plant_name,
        capacity_mw,
        total_maintenance_costs,
        revenue_losses,
        maintenance_cost_efficiency,
        revenue_loss_rate,
        mroi,
        CASE 
            WHEN mroi > 1.5 THEN 'URGENT'
            WHEN mroi BETWEEN 1 AND 1.5 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN mroi BETWEEN 0.5 AND 1 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS priority_level
    FROM 
        maintenance_metrics
)

SELECT 
    se.zoneref AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    AVG(
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 100
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 10 AND 40 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp < 20 THEN 100 - (20 - se.ambictemp) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.ambictemp - 30) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.4
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 40 AND 60 THEN 100
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 80 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct < 40 THEN 100 - (40 - se.humepct) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.humepct - 60) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 
                    100 - (50000 - se.illumelux) * 0.2
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
    ) AS average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    scanenvironment se
JOIN 
    sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY 
    se.zoneref, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_performance_alert()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $ 
DECLARE 
    panel_threshold NUMERIC := 0.7; -- 0.7% degradation per year
    recent_interval INTERVAL := INTERVAL '3 months'; -- Define recent past interval
BEGIN 
    -- Check if performance meets the threshold
    IF (NEW.measpoww / NEW.powratew - 1) * 100 < panel_threshold THEN
        -- Check for similar recent alerts
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM alerts a
            WHERE a.deviceref = NEW.solmodref
              AND a.alertmoment >= NOW() - recent_interval
        ) THEN
            -- Update existing alert
            UPDATE alerts
            SET alertcnt = alertcnt + 1,
                alertmoment = NOW()
            WHERE deviceref = NEW.solmodref
              AND alertmoment >= NOW() - recent_interval;
        ELSE
            -- Insert new alert
            INSERT INTO alerts (
                deviceref, alertmoment, alertstat, alertcnt, maintprior, replaceprior, optpotential
            ) VALUES (
                NEW.solmodref, NOW(), 'Critical', 1, 'High', 'High', 'Medium'
            );
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW; 
END; 
$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Create trigger to call the function after insert on performance table
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_performance_alert
AFTER INSERT ON performance
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION generate_performance_alert();

WITH wireless_devices AS (
    SELECT 
        t.sessionregistry,
        d.makername,
        d.modnum,
        t.battlifeh AS battery_life,
        t.battcapmah AS battery_capacity,
        d.pwridlemw AS idle_power_consumption,
        d.pwractmw AS active_power_consumption,
        d.conntype
    FROM 
        testsessions t
    JOIN 
        deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
    WHERE 
        d.conntype ILIKE '%wireless%' -- Filter for wireless devices
),
battery_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        wd.*,
        (
            (battery_capacity / 3.6) / -- Convert mAh to Wh
            NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0) -- Average power consumption in mW
        ) * 10 AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
        END AS battery_efficiency_classification
    FROM 
        wireless_devices wd
),
percentile_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        be.*,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY makername ORDER BY battery_efficiency_ratio DESC) AS percentile_ranking
    FROM 
        battery_efficiency be
)
SELECT 
    makername,
    modnum,
    battery_life,
    battery_capacity,
    (idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2 AS power_draw,
    battery_efficiency_ratio,
    battery_efficiency_classification,
    percentile_ranking
FROM 
    percentile_ranking;

CREATE VIEW esi_view AS

    s.zonelabel,

    s.gridtrace, 
    s.geox,

    s.heightm, 
    s.depthc,

            ELSE 0.5

        CASE 
            WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 1 
            ELSE 0.5

        CASE 
            WHEN se.photomap = '90%' THEN 1 
            WHEN se.photomap = '80%' THEN 0.85 
            WHEN se.photomap = '60%' THEN 0.7 
            ELSE 0.5

FROM

JOIN

WITH RotationSchedule AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry AS artifact_id,
        a.artname AS artifact_name,
        a.mattype AS material_type,
        u.displaydurmonths AS current_display_duration,
        dsd."Display Safety Duration (DSD)" AS display_limit,
        ((dsd."Display Safety Duration (DSD)" - u.displaydurmonths) * 
        CASE 
            WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1.5
            WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 1.0
            WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 0.5
            ELSE 1.0 -- Default value if light sensitivity is unknown
        END * ar.conservepriorityscore) / 100.0 AS calculated_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN ((dsd."Display Safety Duration (DSD)" - u.displaydurmonths) * 
                CASE 
                    WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1.5
                    WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Low' THEN 0.5
                    ELSE 1.0 -- Default value if light sensitivity is unknown
                END * ar.conservepriorityscore) / 100.0 < 0 
            THEN 'Immediate Rotation' 
            ELSE 'Monitor'
        END AS recommendation
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        usagerecords u ON a.artregistry = u.artrefused
    JOIN 
        artifactratings ar ON a.artregistry = ar.artref
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
    JOIN 
        external_knowledge dsd ON dsd.name = 'Display Safety Duration (DSD)'
    WHERE 
        u.displayrotatesched = 'Active'
)
SELECT 
    artifact_id,
    artifact_name,
    material_type,
    current_display_duration,
    display_limit,
    calculated_score,
    recommendation
FROM 
    RotationSchedule
ORDER BY 
    artifact_id;

            WHEN (t1.carbontons * t1.renewenergypct * t1.recyclepct) BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium'

WITH light_sensitivity AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry AS "Registry Number", 
        t1.artname AS "Name", 
        t1.mattype AS "Material Type", 
        t2.lightsensitivity AS "Light Sensitivity", 
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 50 
            WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 200 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS safe_light_level,
        MAX(t3.lightlux) AS max_light_level
    FROM artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    JOIN lightandradiationreadings AS t3
    GROUP BY t1.artregistry, t1.artname, t1.mattype, t2.lightsensitivity
)
SELECT 
    "Registry Number",
    "Name",
    "Material Type",
    "Light Sensitivity",
    CASE 
        WHEN max_light_level > safe_light_level THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS "Current Status"
FROM light_sensitivity;

WITH tsl_cte AS (

        e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
        i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
        pe.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS cum_deg_pct
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        performance pe ON p.panemark = pe.solmodref
    JOIN 
        environment e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry
    JOIN 
        inverter i ON p.hubregistry = i.siteref
)
SELECT 
    panel_id,
    power_rated_w,
    measured_power_w,
    soiling_loss_pct,
    inverter_efficiency_pct,
    cum_deg_pct,
    (
        (power_rated_w * cum_deg_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * soiling_loss_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * (1 - inverter_efficiency_pct / 100))
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    tsl_cte;

            WHEN (t.totaldeliverytons / dh.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100) * 100 < 30

    (mf.faultpredscore + (1 / mf.rulhours)) AS maintenance_priority,

SELECT 
    o.observstation AS site_name,
    t.telescregistry AS telescope_id,
    -- Calculate the quality score
    (o.atmostransparency * 100) + 
    CASE 
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Excellent' THEN 100
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Good' THEN 75
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Poor' THEN 25
        ELSE 0
    END AS calculated_score,
    -- List equipment problems
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.equipstatus) AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.equipstatus) AS issue_count,
    -- Determine confidence level based on seeing profile
    CASE 
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Excellent' THEN 'High'
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Good' THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN o.seeingprofile = 'Poor' THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS confidence_level
FROM 
    observatories o
JOIN 
    telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
GROUP BY 
    o.observstation, t.telescregistry, o.atmostransparency, o.seeingprofile
ORDER BY 
    calculated_score DESC;

CREATE TYPE battery_efficiency_enum AS ENUM ('Low', 'Medium', 'High');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE (
    device_id VARCHAR,
    efficiency_value NUMERIC,
    efficiency_classification battery_efficiency_enum
)
AS $ 
DECLARE
    rec RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR rec IN
        SELECT 
            t1.devregistry AS device_id,
            (t2.battcapmah / NULLIF(t2.chgtimemin, 0)) * t2.battlifeh AS efficiency_value
        FROM 
            DeviceIdentity AS t1
        JOIN 
            TestSessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
        WHERE 
            t1.conntype IN ('Wireless', 'Bluetooth')
    LOOP
        RETURN QUERY SELECT 
            rec.device_id,
            rec.efficiency_value,
            CASE 
                WHEN rec.efficiency_value > 100 THEN 'High'::battery_efficiency_enum
                WHEN rec.efficiency_value BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'::battery_efficiency_enum
                ELSE 'Low'::battery_efficiency_enum
            END AS efficiency_classification;
    END LOOP;
END;
$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

WITH SilentSupporters AS (
    SELECT 
        f.nicklabel,
        f.userregistry,
        (ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd) AS economic_impact,
        e.engrate AS engagement_rate,
        ms.membkind AS membership_tier,
        (ms.spendusd / (i.engagement_metrics->>'watchhrs')::decimal) AS revenue_per_view,
        e.contpref AS content_preference_classification,
        (
            (cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd + cc.merchspendusd) / (
                ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd
            )
        ) AS activity_ratio,
        (i.engagement_metrics->>'chatmsg')::decimal / (i.engagement_metrics->>'liveatt')::decimal AS chat_to_session_ratio,
        mv.monetization_value
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending ms ON f.userregistry = ms.memberfanpivot
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN 
        commerceandcollection cc ON e.engagereg = cc.commerceengagepivot
    JOIN 
        interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            ms.memberfanpivot,
            (ms.spendusd + cc.merchspendusd + cc.digown + cc.physown + i.giftvalusd) / (
                e.engrate + 1
            ) AS monetization_value
        FROM 
            membershipandspending ms
        JOIN 
            engagement e ON ms.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
        JOIN 
            commerceandcollection cc ON e.engagereg = cc.commerceengagepivot
        JOIN 
            interactions i ON e.engageactivitypivot = i.activityreg
    ) mv ON f.userregistry = mv.memberfanpivot
    WHERE 
        mv.monetization_value > 100
        AND e.engrate < 0.3
        AND (i.engagement_metrics->>'chatmsg')::decimal / (i.engagement_metrics->>'liveatt')::decimal < 0.5
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel, 
    economic_impact, 
    engagement_rate, 
    activity_ratio, 
    membership_tier, 
    revenue_per_view, 
    content_preference_classification
FROM 
    SilentSupporters;

SELECT

    t3.durabilityscore AS durability_score,
    t3.dustres AS dust_resistance_length,
    t3.waterres AS water_resistance_length,
    t3.bendforce AS bend_force,
    (
        t3.durabilityscore * (
            1 + (
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN t3.dustres ILIKE 'IPX0' THEN 0
                        WHEN t3.dustres ILIKE 'IPX1' THEN 1
                        WHEN t3.dustres ILIKE 'IPX2' THEN 2
                        WHEN t3.dustres ILIKE 'IPX3' THEN 3
                    END +
                    CASE
                        WHEN t3.waterres ILIKE 'IPX0' THEN 0
                        WHEN t3.waterres ILIKE 'IPX1' THEN 1
                        WHEN t3.waterres ILIKE 'IPX2' THEN 2
                        WHEN t3.waterres ILIKE 'IPX3' THEN 3
                    END
                ) / 6.0
            )
        ) * (
            1 - (
                (100 - t3.bendforce) / 200.0
            )
        )
    ) AS per_value
FROM
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN interactionandcontrol AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.interactdevref

ORDER BY
