AS $ $
DECLARE
    current_market_factor NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Get the current market factor
    SELECT mkteffect INTO current_market_factor
    FROM systemmonitoring
    ORDER BY systemmonitoringpivot DESC
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Calculate MIC for new orders and log the values
    INSERT INTO market_impact_cost_log (ordersmark, mic)
    SELECT
        recordvault, -- Assuming recordvault is the order reference
        current_market_factor * notionsum AS calculated_mic
    FROM orders
    WHERE orderflow = 'New';
END;
$ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

SELECT 
    signalregistry AS signal_identifier,
    centerfreqmhz AS central_frequency,
    freqdrifthzs AS drift_rate,
    bwhz / freqmhz AS bandwidth_ratio,
    freqdrifthzs AS ntm_classification
FROM 
    signals
WHERE 
    signalclass = 'Narrowband';

CREATE VIEW site_esi AS
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.zonelabel,
    -- Calculate environmental score based on various factors
    (
        (CASE WHEN s.presstat = 'Excellent' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN s.entrystat = 'Open' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN s.saferank = 'High' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN s.insurstat = 'Expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN s.riskeval = 'Completed' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN s.healtheval = 'Approved' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN s.envhaz = 'High' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
        (se.ambictemp * 0.1) +
        (se.humepct * 0.05) +
        (se.illumelux * 0.01) +
        (CASE WHEN se.geosignal = 'Excellent' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN se.trackstatus = 'Fixed' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN se.linkstatus = 'Connected' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN se.photomap = '90%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
        (se.imgcount * 0.02)
    ) AS environmental_score
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanenvironment se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref;

WITH DynastyConservation AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        SUM(ra.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%adequate%' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus ILIKE '%insufficient%' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(cm.conservefreq) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM conservationandmaintenance cm_sub 
                JOIN artifactscore a_sub ON cm_sub.artrefmaintained = a_sub.artregistry 
                WHERE a_sub.artdynasty = a.artdynasty 
                AND cm_sub.budgetallocstatus ILIK '%insufficient%'
            ) THEN 'Budget Crisis'
            ELSE 'Within Budget'
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    LEFT JOIN 
        riskassessments ra ON a.artregistry = ra.artrefconcerned
    LEFT JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
SummaryRow AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS Dynasty,
        SUM(TotalConservationPriorityIndex) AS TotalConservationPriorityIndex,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BudgetStatus = 'Budget Crisis' THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END) AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyConservation
)

SELECT * FROM DynastyConservation
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM SummaryRow;

SELECT 
  s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
  s.zonelabel AS site_name,
  s.presstat AS structural_condition,
  s.riskeval AS status,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.riskeval = 'Required' THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' 
    ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' 
  END AS risk_category
FROM 
  sites AS s;

WITH high_fidelity_mesh AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneref AS site_code,
        COUNT(*) AS total_mesh_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
        AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
        AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_mm,
        -- Assuming Mesh Quality is derived from uvmapqual
        ARRAY_AGG(sm.uvmapqual) AS mesh_quality
    FROM 
        scanmesh AS sm
    JOIN 
        sites AS s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY 
        s.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    hfm.site_code,
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    hfm.total_mesh_count,
    hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (hfm.high_fidelity_mesh_count * 100.0 / hfm.total_mesh_count) AS proportion_high_fidelity,
    hfm.avg_geometric_accuracy,
    hfm.avg_resolution_mm,
    hfm.mesh_quality
FROM 
    high_fidelity_mesh AS hfm
JOIN 
    sites AS s ON hfm.site_code = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY 
    proportion_high_fidelity DESC;
